		public bool TryAttachColumnInternalsContextualRibbon(ScreenContentControl screen)
		{
			if (screen == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("screen");
			}
			if (screen.ScreenSubject != null && !string.Equals(screen.ScreenSubject.NavigationGroupKey, NavigationGroupKeys.SimulationGroup, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				return false;
			}
			IFormedScreenInfo val = (IFormedScreenInfo)(object)((screen is IFormedScreenInfo) ? screen : null);
			string text = null;
			if (val != null)
			{
				text = FormedScreenInfoExtensions.GetMainNodePath(val);
			}
			if (screen.UnityContainer != null && IsScreenForRadfrac(screen.UnityContainer, text))
			{
				string lastBlockFullPath = GetLastBlockFullPath(text);
				_cxsDataProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<CxsDataProvider>(screen.UnityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (((_cxsDataProvider.BatchGet(lastBlockFullPath, "columnanalyzerflag", (string)null) as int?) ?? 0) != 1)
				{
					return false;
				}
				screen.ApplyContextualRibbonTab("ColumnInternalRibbonTabKey");
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void CloseHydraulicPlotsScreen(IUnityContainer container, string columnOptionDataPath)
		{
			if (container == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("container");
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(columnOptionDataPath))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Parameter columnOptionDataPath cannot be null or empty.");
			}
			int num = columnOptionDataPath.IndexOf("Subobjects.Column Internals");
			columnOptionDataPath.Substring(0, num - 1);
			IShellMainWindow val = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IShellMainWindow>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			IEnumerable<ScreenContentControl> enumerable = val.SelectScreens((Func<ScreenContentControl, bool>)((ScreenContentControl p) => p.ScreenFactoryKey == "HydraulicPlotsScreenFactoryKey" && p.ScreenSubject is HydraulicPlotsScreenSubject && (p.ScreenSubject as HydraulicPlotsScreenSubject).ColumnOptionKey == columnOptionDataPath));
			if (enumerable == null || enumerable.Count() <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ScreenContentControl item in enumerable)
			{
				val.CloseScreen(item);
			}
		}

		private static bool IsScreenForRadfrac(IUnityContainer container, string mainNodePath)
		{
			if (container == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("container");
			}
			IApwnApplication val = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IApwnApplication>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (val != null && val.ActiveDocument != null)
			{
				CxsCase val2 = val.ActiveDocument.Case;
				if (val2 != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(mainNodePath))
				{
					try
					{
						if (string.Equals(val2.BatchGet(mainNodePath, "type") as string, "RadFrac", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
						{
							return true;
						}
						if (string.Equals(val2.BatchGet(mainNodePath, "container_type") as string, "RadFrac", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
						{
							return true;
						}
						string lastBlockFullPath = GetLastBlockFullPath(mainNodePath);
						if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(lastBlockFullPath))
						{
							if (string.Equals(val2.BatchGet(lastBlockFullPath, "type") as string, "RadFrac", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
							{
								return true;
							}
							if (string.Equals(val2.BatchGet(lastBlockFullPath, "container_type") as string, "RadFrac", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
							{
								return true;
							}
						}
					}
					catch (COMException)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static string GetLastBlockFullPath(string path)
		{
			int num = path.LastIndexOf("Blocks.", path.Length - 1, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			int num2 = path.IndexOf(".", num + 7);
			int length;
			if (num2 == -1)
			{
				num2 = path.Length - 1;
				length = num2 - num - 6;
			}
			else
			{
				length = num2 - num - 7;
			}
			string text = path.Substring(num + 7, length);
			return path.Substring(0, num) + "Blocks." + text;
		}
	}
	public class ColumnAnalysisRibbonAddIn : IShellRibbonAddIn
	{
		private readonly IUnityContainer _unityContainer;

		public ColumnAnalysisRibbonAddIn(IUnityContainer unityContainer)
		{
			if (unityContainer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("unityContainer");
			}
			_unityContainer = unityContainer;
		}

		public void AddContentToRibbon(IShellMainWindow window, XamRibbon ribbon)
		{
			ResolveAddContextualTabGroup<ColumnInternalTabGroup>(ribbon, "ColumnInternalRibbonTabKey");
		}

		private void ResolveAddContextualTabGroup<T>(XamRibbon ribbon, string key) where T : ContextualTabGroup
		{
			T val = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<T>(_unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			((ContextualTabGroup)val).Key = key;
			((Collection<ContextualTabGroup>)(object)ribbon.ContextualTabGroups).Add((ContextualTabGroup)(object)val);
		}
	}
	public static class ContextualRibbonTabKeys
	{
		public const string ColumnInternalRibbonTabKey = "ColumnInternalRibbonTabKey";

		public static void ApplyContextualRibbonTab(this ScreenContentControl screen, string contextualRibbonTabKey)
		{
			if (screen == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("screen");
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(contextualRibbonTabKey))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Parameter cannot be null or empty.", "contextualRibbonTabKey");
			}
			if (!screen.RequiredContextualTabs.Contains(contextualRibbonTabKey))
			{
				screen.RequiredContextualTabs.Add(contextualRibbonTabKey);
			}
		}
	}

		public bool IsHydraulicPlotsCanBeUsed
		{
			get
			{
				IApwnApplication val = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IApwnApplication>(_unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (val == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				IApwnDocument activeDocument = val.ActiveDocument;
				if (activeDocument == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				CxsCase val2 = activeDocument.Case;
				if (val2 == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (MmgSor.SolverThreadIsActive())
				{
					return false;
				}
				string fullPathOnlyContainsBlocks = GetFullPathOnlyContainsBlocks();
				if (!IsCurrentBlockRadFrac(fullPathOnlyContainsBlocks, val2))
				{
					_isCurrentBlockRadfrac = false;
					return false;
				}
				_isCurrentBlockRadfrac = true;
				if (HelperFuncs.SMDoesAnyCAOptionExistMM() == 0)
				{
					_isNoOptions = true;
					return false;
				}
				_isNoOptions = false;
				string activeOptionIDRef = string.Empty;
				string empty = string.Empty;
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(GetActiveOptionModeFullPath(val2, fullPathOnlyContainsBlocks, ref activeOptionIDRef)))
				{
					if (_columnCAWatch != null)
					{
						_columnCAWatch.ValuesChanged -= _columnCAWatch_ValuesChanged;
						_columnCAWatch.Unload();
						_columnCAWatch = null;
					}
					return false;
				}
				empty = fullPathOnlyContainsBlocks + ".Subobjects.Column Internals." + activeOptionIDRef;
				UpdateStatusWatch(empty);
				int? num = null;
				string text = empty + ".Subobjects.Sections";
				_isNoSections = GetSectionCountForOption(val2, text, out var _) == 0;
				if (_isNoSections)
				{
					return false;
				}
				num = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(_columnCAWatch.Values[0]) ?? 0;
				_isInputIncomplete = (num & 0x40) != 0;
				string path = CxsPath.CombinePaths(fullPathOnlyContainsBlocks, "Output.HYD_TL");
				if (GetChildCount(val2, path) == 0)
				{
					_isResultsAvailable = false;
					return false;
				}
				_isResultsAvailable = true;
				string[] array = CxsConverter.ValueToOptionArray(val2.BatchGet(text, "child_ids", (string)null));
				bool flag = true;
				bool flag2 = false;
				List<int> list = new List<int>();
				string[] array2 = array;
				foreach (string text2 in array2)
				{
					string text3 = CxsPath.CombinePaths(text, text2);
					int? num2 = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(val2.BatchGet(text3, "status_code", (string)null));
					if (num2.HasValue)
					{
						flag2 = (num2.Value & 0x40) != 0;
					}
					if (!flag2)
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					int? num3 = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(val2.BatchGet(CxsPath.CombinePaths(text3, "Input.CA_STAGE1." + activeOptionIDRef + "." + text2), "value", (string)null));
					int? num4 = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(val2.BatchGet(CxsPath.CombinePaths(text3, "Input.CA_STAGE2." + activeOptionIDRef + "." + text2), "value", (string)null));
					if (!num3.HasValue || !num4.HasValue)
					{
						continue;
					}
					for (int j = num3.Value; j <= num4.Value; j++)
					{
						if (list.Contains(j))
						{
							return false;
						}
						list.Add(j);
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

				}
				CxsCase val2 = activeDocument.Case;
				if (val2 == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (MmgSor.SolverThreadIsActive())
				{
					return false;
				}
				string fullPathOnlyContainsBlocks = GetFullPathOnlyContainsBlocks();
				if (!IsCurrentBlockRadFrac(fullPathOnlyContainsBlocks, val2))
				{
					_isCurrentBlockRadfrac = false;
					return false;
				}
				_isCurrentBlockRadfrac = true;
				if (HelperFuncs.SMDoesAnyCAOptionExistMM() == 0)
				{
					_isNoOptions = true;
					return false;
				}
				_isNoOptions = false;
				string activeOptionIDRef = string.Empty;
				string empty = string.Empty;
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(GetActiveOptionModeFullPath(val2, fullPathOnlyContainsBlocks, ref activeOptionIDRef)))
				{
					if (_columnCAWatch != null)
					{
						_columnCAWatch.ValuesChanged -= _columnCAWatch_ValuesChanged;
						_columnCAWatch.Unload();
						_columnCAWatch = null;
					}
					return false;
				}
				empty = fullPathOnlyContainsBlocks + ".Subobjects.Column Internals." + activeOptionIDRef;
				UpdateStatusWatch(empty);
				int? num = null;
				string path = empty + ".Subobjects.Sections";
				_isNoSections = GetSectionCountForOption(val2, path, out var _) == 0;
				if (_isNoSections)
				{
					return false;
				}
				num = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(_columnCAWatch.Values[0]) ?? 0;
				_isInputIncomplete = (num & 0x40) != 0;
				if (_isInputIncomplete)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (_cablockPath != null)
				{
					string text = CxsPath.CombinePaths(_cablockPath, "Output.HYD_TL");
					string[] array = CxsConverter.ValueToStringArray(val2.BatchGet(text, "child_ids", (string)null));
					_isResultsAvailable = false;
					if (array == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					_isResultsAvailable = true;
				}
				else
				{
					_isResultsAvailable = (num & 1) != 0;
					if (!_isResultsAvailable)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private Dictionary<string, bool> GetOptionReportEnabledInfo()
		{
			Dictionary<string, bool> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, bool>();
			IApwnApplication val = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IApwnApplication>(_unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (val == null)
			{
				return dictionary;
			}
			IApwnDocument activeDocument = val.ActiveDocument;
			if (activeDocument == null)
			{
				return dictionary;
			}
			CxsCase val2 = activeDocument.Case;
			if (val2 == null)
			{
				return dictionary;
			}
			if (HelperFuncs.SMDoesAnyCAOptionExistMM() != 0)
			{
				string fullPathOnlyContainsBlocks = GetFullPathOnlyContainsBlocks();
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fullPathOnlyContainsBlocks))
				{
					string path = CxsPath.CombinePaths(fullPathOnlyContainsBlocks, "Output.HYD_TL");
					if (GetChildCount(val2, path) == 0)
					{
						return dictionary;
					}
					string empty = string.Empty;
					string text = fullPathOnlyContainsBlocks + ".Subobjects.Column Internals";
					string[] array = CxsConverter.ValueToOptionArray(val2.BatchGet(text, "child_ids", (string)null));
					if (array != null && array.Length != 0)
					{
						ISimulatorCADataProvider simulatorCADataProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
						string[] array2 = array;
						foreach (string text2 in array2)
						{
							empty = fullPathOnlyContainsBlocks + ".Subobjects.Column Internals." + text2;
							string text3 = empty + ".Subobjects.Sections";
							if (GetSectionCountForOption(val2, text3, out var _) == 0)
							{
								dictionary.Add(text2, value: false);
								continue;
							}
							string[] array3 = CxsConverter.ValueToOptionArray(val2.BatchGet(text3, "child_ids", (string)null));
							bool flag = true;
							bool flag2 = false;
							string[] array4 = array3;
							foreach (string text4 in array4)
							{
								string text5 = CxsPath.CombinePaths(text3, text4);
								int? num = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(val2.BatchGet(text5, "status_code", (string)null));
								if (num.HasValue)
								{
									flag2 = (num.Value & 0x40) != 0;
								}
								if (flag2)
								{
									flag = false;
									break;
								}
								if (!flag || simulatorCADataProvider == null)
								{
									continue;
								}
								SimSectionDataBase simSectionData = simulatorCADataProvider.GetSimSectionData(empty, text4);
								if (simSectionData == null)
								{
									continue;
								}
								bool flag3 = simSectionData.GetType() == typeof(CATraySectionData) || simSectionData.GetType().IsSubclassOf(typeof(CATraySectionData));
								try
								{
									if (flag3)
									{
										if (simulatorCADataProvider.GetTraySectionResultData(empty, text4) == null)
										{
											flag = false;
											break;
										}
									}
									else if (simulatorCADataProvider.GetPackingSectionResultData(empty, text4) == null)
									{
										flag = false;
										break;
									}
								}
								catch (Exception)
								{
								}
							}
							if (flag && AreSectionsOverLapped(simulatorCADataProvider, empty))
							{
								flag = false;
							}
							dictionary.Add(text2, flag);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		private static bool AreSectionsOverLapped(ISimulatorCADataProvider provider, string optionKey)
		{
			List<CASectionRange> list = provider.GetSectionsRange(optionKey) as List<CASectionRange>;
			new List<string>();
			if (list == null || list.Count < 2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				if (list[i].StartStageNumber == 0 || list[i].EndStageNumber == 0 || list[i].StartStageNumber > list[i].EndStageNumber)
				{
					continue;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
				{
					if (j != i && ((list[i].StartStageNumber <= list[j].StartStageNumber && list[i].EndStageNumber >= list[j].StartStageNumber) || (list[i].StartStageNumber <= list[j].EndStageNumber && list[i].EndStageNumber >= list[j].EndStageNumber)))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsCurrentBlockRadFrac(string pathOnlyContainBlocks, CxsCase cxsCase)
		{
			if (MmgSor.SolverThreadIsActive())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (cxsCase != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(pathOnlyContainBlocks))
			{
				try
				{
					if (string.Equals(cxsCase.BatchGet(pathOnlyContainBlocks, "type") as string, "RadFrac", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (string.Equals(cxsCase.BatchGet(pathOnlyContainBlocks, "container_type") as string, "RadFrac", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
					{
						return true;
					}
					string lastBlockFullPath = GetLastBlockFullPath(pathOnlyContainBlocks);
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(lastBlockFullPath))
					{
						if (string.Equals(cxsCase.BatchGet(lastBlockFullPath, "type") as string, "RadFrac", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
						{
							return true;
						}
						if (string.Equals(cxsCase.BatchGet(lastBlockFullPath, "container_type") as string, "RadFrac", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				catch (COMException)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private string GetLastBlockFullPath(string path)
		{
			int num = path.LastIndexOf("Blocks.", path.Length - 1, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			int num2 = path.IndexOf(".", num + 7);
			int length;
			if (num2 == -1)
			{
				num2 = path.Length - 1;
				length = num2 - num - 6;
			}
			else
			{
				length = num2 - num - 7;
			}
			string text = path.Substring(num + 7, length);
			return path.Substring(0, num) + "Blocks." + text;
		}

		private int GetSectionCountForOption(CxsCase cxsCase, string path, out string[] sections)
		{
			sections = CxsConverter.ValueToOptionArray(cxsCase.BatchGet(path, "child_ids", (string)null));
			if (sections != null)
			{
				return sections.Length;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		private int GetChildCount(CxsCase cxsCase, string path)
		{
			string[] array = CxsConverter.ValueToOptionArray(cxsCase.BatchGet(path, "child_ids", (string)null));
			if (array != null)
			{
				return array.Length;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		private bool ContainsTray(CxsCase cxsCase, string path, string[] sections)
		{
			foreach (string text in sections)
			{
				string text2 = path + "." + text;
				if (string.Equals(CxsConverter.ValueToString(cxsCase.BatchGet(text2, "value", (string)null)), "TRAY", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		{

		private List<string> GetAllBlockID()
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			string mainNodePath = GetMainNodePath();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(mainNodePath))
			{
				mainNodePath = mainNodePath.Replace("Top.appModelV8.", string.Empty);
				string[] array = mainNodePath.Split('.');
				if (array != null)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
					{
						if (string.Equals(array[i], "Blocks", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase) && i < array.Length - 1)
						{
							list.Add(array[i + 1]);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private List<string> GetAllBlockID(string baseMainPath)

				text = baseMainPath;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				text = text.Replace("Top.appModelV8.", string.Empty);
				string[] array = text.Split('.');
				if (array != null)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
					{
						if (string.Equals(array[i], "Blocks", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase) && i < array.Length - 1)
						{
							list.Add(array[i + 1]);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private string GetFullPathOnlyContainsBlocks()
		{
			string empty = string.Empty;
			string mainNodePath = GetMainNodePath();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(mainNodePath))
			{
				int num = mainNodePath.LastIndexOf("Blocks.", mainNodePath.Length - 1, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
				if (num == -1)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				int num2 = mainNodePath.IndexOf(".", num + 7);
				if (num2 == -1)
				{
					return mainNodePath;
				}
				return mainNodePath.Substring(0, num2);
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public void CreateNewAndThenNavigate(string baseMainPath)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_016a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fullPathOnlyContainsBlocks) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(baseMainPath))
			{
				fullPathOnlyContainsBlocks = GetFullPathOnlyContainsBlocks(baseMainPath);
			}
			string text = fullPathOnlyContainsBlocks + ".Subobjects.Column Internals";
			CxsDataProvider dataProvider = DataProvider;
			string[] array = new string[1] { text };
			string[] array2 = new string[1] { "default_name" };
			val.AddRequests(array, new string[1], array2);
			try
			{
				dataProvider.UpdateDataCache(val);
				dataProvider.InvokeAction("Top.appModelV8.Custom Actions", "CAClearCache", false, (object[])null);
			}
			catch (CxsException)
			{
			}
			try
			{
				empty = dataProvider.BatchGet(val)[0] as string;
			}
			catch (CxsException)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				dataProvider.InvokeAction("Top.appModelV8.Custom Actions", "InitializeNewNode", true, new object[1] { 1 });
				dataProvider.InvokeAction(text, "InsertChild", false, new object[1] { empty });
				dataProvider.InvokeAction("Top.appModelV8.Custom Actions", "InitializeNewNode", true, new object[1] { 0 });
				string text2 = fullPathOnlyContainsBlocks + ".Subobjects.Column Internals." + empty + ".Input.CA_ACTIVE1." + empty;
				dataProvider.BatchSet(text2, "value", (string)null, (object)"YES");
				GoToColumnInternalsActiveNode(new string[1] { empty }, dataProvider, fullPathOnlyContainsBlocks);
				((CompositePresentationEvent<ColumnInternalsInvokedEventArgs>)(object)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(dataProvider.UnityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<ColumnInternalsInvoked>()).Publish(new ColumnInternalsInvokedEventArgs());
			}
			catch (CxsException)
			{
			}
		}

		private void Case_Message(object sender, CxsMessageEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			foreach (CxsMessage message in e.Messages)
			{
				CxsMessage current = message;
				if ((int)((CxsMessage)(ref current)).MessageType != 13)
				{
					continue;
				}
				int num = 0;
				if (((CxsMessage)(ref current)).MessageData != null && ((CxsMessage)(ref current)).MessageData.Count > 0 && ((CxsMessage)(ref current)).MessageData[0] != null && int.TryParse(((CxsMessage)(ref current)).MessageData[0].ToString(), out var result))
				{
					num = result;
				}
				if (((CxsMessage)(ref current)).Number != 1005 || (num != 109 && num != 111 && num != 102))
				{
					continue;
				}
				((DispatcherObject)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					if (bNeedstoContinueToCreatechild)
					{
						CxsDataProvider dataProvider = DataProvider;
						CreateNewAndThenNavigate(_lastDoColumnInternalsPath);
						dataProvider.Case.Message -= Case_Message;
					}
				}, DispatcherPriority.Normal);
			}
		}

		public void DoColumnInternals(DoColumnInternalsEventArgs parameter)
		{
			CxsDataProvider dataProvider = DataProvider;
			string fullPathOnlyContainsBlocks = GetFullPathOnlyContainsBlocks();
			_lastDoColumnInternalsPath = ((parameter != null) ? parameter.Path : null);
			string text = fullPathOnlyContainsBlocks + ".Subobjects.Column Internals";
			string[] array = CxsConverter.ValueToOptionArray(dataProvider.BatchGet(text, "child_ids", (string)null));
			if (array != null && array.Count() > 0)
			{
				GoToColumnInternalsActiveNode(array, dataProvider, fullPathOnlyContainsBlocks);
				return;
			}
			bNeedstoContinueToCreatechild = false;
			if (((HelperFuncs.GetRunAnyWayValue() == 1 && HelperFuncs.IsInputNotComplete() == 1) || HelperFuncs.IsInputNotComplete() == 0) && !SimulatorCADataProvider.IsHydraulicProfilePresent(fullPathOnlyContainsBlocks, dataProvider))
			{
				dataProvider.Case.Message += Case_Message;
				if (SimulatorCADataProvider.RunWithHydraulicFlagOn(fullPathOnlyContainsBlocks, dataProvider))
				{
					bNeedstoContinueToCreatechild = true;
					return;
				}
				dataProvider.Case.Message -= Case_Message;
			}
			CreateNewAndThenNavigate((parameter != null) ? parameter.Path : null);
		}

		private void GoToColumnInternalsActiveNode(string[] optionIDs, CxsDataProvider cxsDataProvider, string pathOnlyContainsBlocks)
		{
			_ = string.Empty;
			string text = string.Empty;
			string empty = string.Empty;
			foreach (string text2 in optionIDs)
			{
				empty = pathOnlyContainsBlocks + ".Subobjects.Column Internals." + text2 + ".Input.CA_ACTIVE1." + text2;
				if (string.Equals(CxsConverter.ValueToString(cxsDataProvider.BatchGet(empty, "value", (string)null)), "YES", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					text = text2;
					break;
				}
			}
			GoToNodeEx("Column Internals." + text + ".Sections", pathOnlyContainsBlocks);
		}

			{
				Group = NavigationGroupKeys.SimulationGroup,

				UseNewTab = useNewTab
			});
		}

		private void GoToNodeEx(string path)
		{
			List<string> allBlockID = GetAllBlockID();
			string text = "Blocks";
			for (int i = 0; i < allBlockID.Count; i++)
			{
				string text2 = allBlockID[i];
				text = ((i == allBlockID.Count - 1) ? (text + "." + text2) : (text + "." + text2 + ".Blocks"));
			}
			GoToNode($"{text}.{path}", null, useNewTab: true);
		}

		private void GoToNodeEx(string path, string baseMainPath)

			}
			GoToNode($"{text}.{path}", null, useNewTab: true);
		}

		public void DoReports(object parameter)
		{
			string fullPathOnlyContainsBlocks = GetFullPathOnlyContainsBlocks();
			string activeOptionFullPath = GetActiveOptionFullPath(UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IApwnApplication>(_unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).ActiveDocument.Case);
			string text = "";
			string text2 = "";
			try
			{
				text = fullPathOnlyContainsBlocks.Substring(fullPathOnlyContainsBlocks.LastIndexOf(".") + 1);
				text2 = activeOptionFullPath.Substring(activeOptionFullPath.LastIndexOf(".") + 1);
			}
			catch (ArgumentOutOfRangeException)
			{
			}
			string defaultHeader = "";
			string subHeader = "";
			IHostApplicationInfo hostApplicationInfo = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IHostApplicationInfo>(_unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (hostApplicationInfo != null && hostApplicationInfo.HostApplicationType == ApplicationType.AspenPlus)
			{
				defaultHeader = "Hydraulic Analysis Report - " + text + " : " + text2;
				subHeader = "Simulation case: " + hostApplicationInfo.CurrentDocumentPath;
			}
			ReportDialog reportDialog = new ReportDialog(_unityContainer, fullPathOnlyContainsBlocks, activeOptionFullPath, GetOptionReportEnabledInfo());
			reportDialog.DefaultHeader = defaultHeader;
			reportDialog.SubHeader1 = "Generated by Aspen Plus " + SystemEnvironment.ExternalVersionString;
			reportDialog.SubHeader2 = subHeader;
			ICAHelp iCAHelp = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ICAHelp>(_unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			iCAHelp.SetHelpFile(reportDialog, "Radfrac");
			iCAHelp.SetHelpId(reportDialog, 1500);
			reportDialog.Owner = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IShellMainWindow>(_unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()) as Window;
			reportDialog.ShowDialog();
		}

	public class CAHelp : ICAHelp
	{
		public void SetHelpFile(DependencyObject obj, string helpFile)
		{
			MMHelp.SetHelpFile(obj, helpFile);
			ProcessInContextGuidance(obj);
		}

		public void SetHelpId(DependencyObject obj, int? helpId)
		{
			MMHelp.SetHelpId(obj, helpId);
			ProcessInContextGuidance(obj);
		}

		private void ProcessInContextGuidance(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			if (obj is ContentControl contentControl)
			{
				string helpFile = MMHelp.GetHelpFile(obj);
				int? helpId = MMHelp.GetHelpId(obj);
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(helpFile) && helpId.HasValue)
				{
					MMInContextGuidanceButton.SetUsedInTemplate((UIElement)contentControl, (bool?)true);
				}
				else
				{
					MMInContextGuidanceButton.SetUsedInTemplate((UIElement)contentControl, (bool?)false);
				}
			}
		}
	}

		public void UpdateRunMode(bool Mode)
		{
			_bIsEngineRun = Mode;
			int num = 0;

			{
				num = 1;
			}
			string blockFullName = GetBlockFullName();
			if (blockFullName != null)
			{
				int? num2 = MmgSor.MMinqrsl();
				int? num3 = MmgSor.MMinqcpt();
				int? num4 = MmgSor.MMinqpgc();
				int num5 = MmgSor.MMinqnec();
				string text = "Top.appModelV8.Blocks." + blockFullName + ".Input.CA_ENG_RUN";
				CxsDataProvider val = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<CxsDataProvider>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (val != null)
				{
					val.BatchSet(text, "value", (string)null, (object)num);
				}
				if (num2.HasValue)
				{
					MmgSor.MMsetrsl(num2.Value);
				}
				if (num3.HasValue)
				{
					MmgSor.MMsetcpt(num3.Value);
				}
				if (num4.HasValue)
				{
					MmgSor.MMsetpgc(num4.Value);

			}
		}

		private CondenserTypeEnum GetCondenserType()
		{
			CondenserTypeEnum result = CondenserTypeEnum.None;
			string text = CxsPath.CombinePaths(_contextMainPath, "Input.CONDENSER");
			string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(_cxsCase.BatchGet(text, "value", (string)null));
			if (text2.ToUpper() == "TOTAL")
			{
				result = CondenserTypeEnum.Total;
			}
			else if (text2.ToUpper() == "PARTIAL-V")
			{
				result = CondenserTypeEnum.PartialVapor;
			}
			else if (text2.ToUpper() == "PARTIAL-V-L")
			{
				result = CondenserTypeEnum.PartialVaporLiquid;
			}
			else if (text2.ToUpper() == "SUBCOOLED")
			{
				result = CondenserTypeEnum.None;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private StatusEnum GetColumnResultStatus()
		{
			StatusEnum result = StatusEnum.Success;
			if (_cxsCase.InvokeAction("Top.appModelV8.Custom Actions", "HappNode", new object[1] { _contextMainPath }) is IHNode iHNode)
			{
				if (((HAPCompStatusCode)(dynamic)iHNode.get_AttributeValue((short)12, (object)null) & HAPCompStatusCode.HAP_RESULTS_INCOMPAT) == HAPCompStatusCode.HAP_RESULTS_INCOMPAT)
				{
					result = StatusEnum.Incompatible;
				}
				else if (((HAPCompStatusCode)(dynamic)iHNode.get_AttributeValue((short)12, (object)null) & HAPCompStatusCode.HAP_RESULTS_ERRORS) == HAPCompStatusCode.HAP_RESULTS_ERRORS)
				{
					result = StatusEnum.Error;
				}
				else if (((HAPCompStatusCode)(dynamic)iHNode.get_AttributeValue((short)12, (object)null) & HAPCompStatusCode.HAP_RESULTS_WARNINGS) == HAPCompStatusCode.HAP_RESULTS_WARNINGS)
				{
					result = StatusEnum.Warning;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public string GetBlockFullName()
		{
			if (_cxsCase.InvokeAction("Top.appModelV8.Custom Actions", "HappNode", new object[1] { _contextMainPath }) is IHNode iHNode)
			{
				return (dynamic)iHNode.get_AttributeValue((short)65, Type.Missing);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private StageType GetStageType(string sectionKey)
		{
			StageType result = StageType.None;
			bool flag = IsARatingOption(_contextOption, sectionKey);
			string text = IsTrayedorPacked(_contextOption, sectionKey);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (flag && text == "TRAY")
			{
				string text2 = MMStringVal(FullColumnName, _contextOption, sectionKey, "CA-FLOOD-MET");
				result = ((string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2) || !text2.Equals("USER", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase)) ? StageType.TrayRating : StageType.TrayRatingWithUserSubroutine);
			}
			else if (flag && text == "PACKING")
			{
				string text3 = MMStringVal(FullColumnName, _contextOption, sectionKey, "CA-DPMETH");
				result = ((string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3) || !text3.Equals("USER", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase)) ? StageType.PackRating : StageType.PackRatingWithUserSubroutine);
			}
			else if (!flag && text == "TRAY")
			{
				string text4 = MMStringVal(FullColumnName, _contextOption, sectionKey, "CA-FLOOD-MET");
				result = ((string.IsNullOrEmpty(text4) || !text4.Equals("USER", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase)) ? StageType.TraySizing : StageType.TraySizingWithUserSubroutine);
			}
			else if (!flag && text == "PACKING")
			{
				string text5 = MMStringVal(FullColumnName, _contextOption, sectionKey, "CA-DPMETH");
				result = ((string.IsNullOrEmpty(text5) || !text5.Equals("USER", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase)) ? StageType.PackSizing : StageType.PackSizingWithUserSubroutine);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void GetSectionsData(ref ColumnInternalsData columnData)
		{
			Sections = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(_cxsCase.BatchGet(_sConfigOption, "child_ids"));
			if (Sections == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (string section in Sections)
			{
				CASectionRange cASectionRange = new CASectionRange(section, section);
				int? num = IntVal(_contextMainPath, _contextOption, section, "Output.CA_ST_STG9");
				if (!_bIsEngineRun || !num.HasValue || num <= 0 || num >= 99999999)
				{
					num = MMIntVal(FullColumnName, _contextOption, section, "CA-STAGE1");
				}
				if (num.HasValue)
				{
					cASectionRange.StartStageNumber = num.Value;
				}
				num = IntVal(_contextMainPath, _contextOption, section, "Output.CA_END_STG9");
				if (!_bIsEngineRun || !num.HasValue || num <= 0 || num >= 99999999)
				{
					num = MMIntVal(FullColumnName, _contextOption, section, "CA-STAGE2");
				}
				if (num.HasValue)
				{
					cASectionRange.EndStageNumber = num.Value;
				}
				cASectionRange.StageType = GetStageType(section);

		private static BalanceDowncomerLoadingBasis BalanceDownComerBasis(string sFullBlockName, string sOptionId, string sSectionId)
		{
			string strA = MMStringVal(sFullBlockName, sOptionId, sSectionId, "CA-DCBASE");
			BalanceDowncomerLoadingBasis result = BalanceDowncomerLoadingBasis.Side;
			if (string.Compare(strA, "SIDE", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				result = BalanceDowncomerLoadingBasis.Side;
			}
			else if (string.Compare(strA, "CENTER", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				result = BalanceDowncomerLoadingBasis.Center;
			}
			else if (string.Compare(strA, "MAXLOAD", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				result = BalanceDowncomerLoadingBasis.MAXLOAD;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static bool IsUserEntered(string sFullBlockName, string sOptionId, string sSectionId, string sMMvar)
		{
			bool? flag = null;
			flag = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sSectionId) ? HelperFuncs.SMRadCA_GetOptionVarUserEntFlagMM(sFullBlockName, sOptionId, sMMvar) : HelperFuncs.SMRadCA_GetVarUserEntFlagMM(sFullBlockName, sOptionId, sSectionId, sMMvar));
			if (flag.HasValue && flag.HasValue && flag.Value)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.CADataType.TrayTypeEnum TrayType(string sMainPath, string sOptionId, string sSectionId, ref bool isDefaultType)
		{
			string text = StringVal(_contextMainPath, sOptionId, sSectionId, "Input.CA_TRAYTYPE");
			AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.CADataType.TrayTypeEnum result = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.CADataType.TrayTypeEnum.BubbleCap;
			if (text.IndexOf("CAP") != -1)
			{
				result = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.CADataType.TrayTypeEnum.BubbleCap;
			}
			else if (text.IndexOf("SIEVE") != -1)
			{
				result = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.CADataType.TrayTypeEnum.Sieve;
			}
			else if (text.IndexOf("BALLAST") != -1)
			{
				result = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.CADataType.TrayTypeEnum.GlitschBallast;
			}
			else if (text.IndexOf("KOCH") != -1)
			{
				result = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.CADataType.TrayTypeEnum.KochFlexitray;
			}
			else if (text.IndexOf("FLEX") != -1)
			{
				result = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.CADataType.TrayTypeEnum.KochFlexitray;
			}
			else if (text.IndexOf("NUTTER") != -1)
			{
				result = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.CADataType.TrayTypeEnum.NutterFloatValve;
			}
			else if (text.IndexOf("CUSTOM") != -1)
			{
				result = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.CADataType.TrayTypeEnum.CustomTray;
			}
			bool? flag = HelperFuncs.SMRadCA_GetVarUserEntFlagMM(FullColumnName, sOptionId, sSectionId, "CA-TRAYTYPE");
			if (!flag.HasValue || !flag.Value)
			{
				isDefaultType = true;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private CATraySectionData GetTraySection(string sMainPath, string sOptionId, string sSectionId)
		{
			CATraySectionData cATraySectionData = null;
			bool isDefaultType = false;
			switch (TrayType(sMainPath, sOptionId, sSectionId, ref isDefaultType))
			{
			case AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.CADataType.TrayTypeEnum.Sieve:
			{
				cATraySectionData = new CASieveTraySectionData(_Container);
				CASieveTraySectionData traySection6 = cATraySectionData as CASieveTraySectionData;
				GetSieveTraySectionDataRating(sMainPath, sOptionId, sSectionId, ref traySection6);
				SetDataForMDTraySection(sMainPath, sOptionId, sSectionId, cATraySectionData);
				break;
			}
			case AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.CADataType.TrayTypeEnum.BubbleCap:
			{
				cATraySectionData = new CABubbleCapTraySection(_Container);
				CABubbleCapTraySection traySection5 = cATraySectionData as CABubbleCapTraySection;
				GetBubbleCapTraySectionRating(sMainPath, sOptionId, sSectionId, ref traySection5);
				break;
			}
			case AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.CADataType.TrayTypeEnum.GlitschBallast:
			{
				cATraySectionData = new CAGlitschBallastValveTraySection(_Container);
				CAGlitschBallastValveTraySection traySection4 = cATraySectionData as CAGlitschBallastValveTraySection;
				GetGlitschBallastValveTraySectionDataFromRating(sMainPath, sOptionId, sSectionId, ref traySection4);
				break;
			}
			case AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.CADataType.TrayTypeEnum.KochFlexitray:
			{
				cATraySectionData = new CAKochFlexitrayValveTraySection(_Container);
				CAKochFlexitrayValveTraySection traySection3 = cATraySectionData as CAKochFlexitrayValveTraySection;
				GetKochFlexitrayValveTraySectionDataFromRating(sMainPath, sOptionId, sSectionId, ref traySection3);
				break;
			}
			case AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.CADataType.TrayTypeEnum.NutterFloatValve:
			{
				cATraySectionData = new CANutterFloatValveTraySection(_Container);
				CANutterFloatValveTraySection traySection2 = cATraySectionData as CANutterFloatValveTraySection;
				GetNutterFloatValveTraySectionDatRating(sMainPath, sOptionId, sSectionId, ref traySection2);
				break;
			}
			case AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.CADataType.TrayTypeEnum.CustomTray:
			{
				cATraySectionData = new CACustomTraySectionData(_Container);
				cATraySectionData.IsCustomTray = true;
				CACustomTraySectionData traySection = cATraySectionData as CACustomTraySectionData;
				GetCustomTraySectionDataRating(sMainPath, sOptionId, sSectionId, ref traySection);
				break;
			}
			}
			cATraySectionData.IsDefaultType = isDefaultType;
			SetCommonDataForTraySection(sMainPath, sOptionId, sSectionId, cATraySectionData);
			return cATraySectionData;
		}

		private CAPackingSectionData GetPackSection(string sMainPath, string sOptionId, string sSectionId)
		{
			CAPackingSectionData cAPackingSectionData = new CAPackingSectionData(_Container);
			cAPackingSectionData.Key = sSectionId;
			cAPackingSectionData.Name = sSectionId;
			string text = MMStringVal(FullColumnName, sOptionId, sSectionId, "CA-PACKTYPE");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				cAPackingSectionData.PackingType.EnumString = text;

		public SimulatorCADataProvider(IUnityContainer container)
		{
			_Container = container;
		}

		private void SetContexts(string sConfigOption)
		{
			int num = sConfigOption.IndexOf("Subobjects.Column Internals");
			if (num != -1)
			{
				_contextMainPath = sConfigOption.Substring(0, num - 1);
				int num2 = sConfigOption.IndexOf(sColumnInternal) + sColumnInternal.Length + 1;
				string[] array = sConfigOption.Substring(num2).Split('.');
				if (array.Count() > 0)
				{
					_contextOption = array[0];
				}
				if (_cxsCase == null)
				{
					_cxsCase = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<CxsCase>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				}
				_sConfigOption = sConfigOption.Substring(0, num2) + _contextOption + "." + _sSectionSubobj;
				Sections = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(_cxsCase.BatchGet(_sConfigOption, "child_ids"));
				FullColumnName = GetBlockFullName();
				IsTopDownNumbering = true;
				Path = _contextMainPath;
			}
		}

		public ColumnInternalsData GetColumnInternalsData(string sConfigOption)
		{
			if (sConfigOption.Equals(FakeInputDataForHYdroPlot.ColumnOptionKey))
			{
				return FakeInputDataForHYdroPlot.GetColInternalData(_Container);
			}
			SetContexts(sConfigOption);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(GetBlockFullName()))
			{
				return null;
			}
			ColumnInternalsData columnData = new ColumnInternalsData();
			columnData.CondenserType = GetCondenserType();
			columnData.ReboilerType = GetReboilerType();
			GetFeedandProductStreamandFeedLocation(ref columnData);
			GetSideOpertionsData(columnData);
			GetHydraulicData(ref columnData);
			columnData.ColumnStatus = GetColumnResultStatus();
			GetSectionsData(ref columnData);
			columnData.FullColumnName = FullColumnName;
			columnData.IsTopDownNumbering = IsTopDownNumbering;
			SetColumnStageRange(columnData);
			if (columnData.CondenserType != CondenserTypeEnum.None)
			{
				columnData.IsStagesContainsCondenser = true;
			}
			return columnData;
		}

		public SimSectionDataBase GetSimSectionData(string sConfigOption, string sectionKey)
		{
			if (sectionKey.Equals(FakeInputDataForHYdroPlot.SectionKey))
			{
				return FakeInputDataForHYdroPlot.GetSectionData(_Container);
			}
			SetContexts(sConfigOption);
			string text = IsTrayedorPacked(_contextOption, sectionKey);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return null;
			}
			string text2 = sConfigOption + ".Subobjects.Sections." + sectionKey;
			bool? isCompleteStatus = null;
			if (_cxsCase.InvokeAction("Top.appModelV8.Custom Actions", "HappNode", new object[1] { text2 }) is IHNode iHNode && ((HAPCompStatusCode)(dynamic)iHNode.get_AttributeValue((short)12, (object)null) & HAPCompStatusCode.HAP_INPUT_INCOMPLETE) == HAPCompStatusCode.HAP_INPUT_INCOMPLETE)
			{
				isCompleteStatus = false;
			}
			GetRunMode();
			if (text == "TRAY")
			{
				CATraySectionData traySection = GetTraySection(_contextMainPath, _contextOption, sectionKey);
				traySection.Key = sectionKey;
				traySection.Name = sectionKey;
				traySection.IsCompleteStatus = isCompleteStatus;
				return traySection;
			}
			if (text == "PACKING")
			{
				CAPackingSectionData packSection = GetPackSection(_contextMainPath, _contextOption, sectionKey);
				packSection.IsCompleteStatus = isCompleteStatus;
				return packSection;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public bool UpdateDefaults(string sOptionKey, string sectionKey, RunOption runOption, bool ensureDowncomerBalanced = false)
		{
			if (_sConfigOption == null || string.Compare(_sConfigOption, sOptionKey) != 0)
			{
				SetContexts(sOptionKey);
			}
			if (FullColumnName == null)
			{
				FullColumnName = GetBlockFullName();
			}
			int nKnt = 0;
			string sMMVars = string.Empty;
			string sValues = string.Empty;
			int num = 1;
			if (sOptionKey.IndexOf("Subobjects.Sections") == -1)
			{
				_sConfigOption = sOptionKey + ".Subobjects.Sections";
			}
			else
			{
				_sConfigOption = sOptionKey;
			}
			string sOptionKeyForCallCA = sOptionKey;
			if (sOptionKey.IndexOf(".Subobjects.Sections") != -1)
			{
				sOptionKeyForCallCA = Regex.Replace(sOptionKey, ".Subobjects.Sections", string.Empty, RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
			}
			int num2 = sOptionKey.IndexOf("Subobjects.Column Internals");
			if (num2 == -1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string text = (_contextMainPath = sOptionKey.Substring(0, num2 - 1));
			int startIndex = sOptionKey.IndexOf(sColumnInternal) + sColumnInternal.Length + 1;
			string text2 = sOptionKey.Substring(startIndex);
			int num3 = text2.IndexOf(".Subobjects.Sections");
			if (num3 != -1)
			{

			{
				_columnAnalyzerModel.Run(sOptionKeyForCallCA, sectionKey);
			});

		}

		private void SetColumnStageRange(ColumnInternalsData colOptionData)
		{
			if (colOptionData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			string text = CxsPath.CombinePaths(_contextMainPath, "Input.NSTAGE");
			int? num3 = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(_cxsCase.BatchGet(text, "value", (string)null));
			if (_bIsEngineRun && colOptionData.Stages.Count > 0)
			{
				num3 = colOptionData.Stages.Count;
			}
			if (num3.HasValue && num3 > 0)
			{
				num = ((colOptionData.CondenserType == CondenserTypeEnum.None) ? 1 : 2);
				num2 = ((colOptionData.ReboilerType != ReboilerTypeEnum.None) ? (num3.Value - 1) : num3.Value);
				if (num2 < num)
				{
					num2 = num;
				}
				colOptionData.StartStageNumber = num;
				colOptionData.EndStageNumber = num2;
			}
		}

		public IList<string> GetUnitList(QuantityTypeEnum QuantityTypeEnum)
		{
			string unitList = HelperFuncs.GetUnitList(VariableHelper.GetPlusDimensionRow(QuantityTypeEnum));
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(unitList))
			{
				return null;
			}
			string[] array = unitList.Split(';');
			if (array.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<string> list = new List<string>(array.Length);
			list.AddRange(list);
			return list;
		}

		public IList<string> GetSectionsKeys(string sConfigOption)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_sConfigOption))
			{
				SetContexts(sConfigOption);
			}
			IList<string> list = new List<string>();
			Sections = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(_cxsCase.BatchGet(_sConfigOption, "child_ids"));
			if (Sections == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (string section in Sections)
			{
				list.Add(section);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public IList<CASectionRange> GetSectionsRange(string sConfigOption)
		{
			SetContexts(sConfigOption);
			IList<CASectionRange> list = new List<CASectionRange>();
			Sections = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(_cxsCase.BatchGet(_sConfigOption, "child_ids"));
			if (Sections == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (string section in Sections)
			{
				CASectionRange cASectionRange = new CASectionRange(section, section);
				int? num = IntVal(_contextMainPath, _contextOption, section, "Output.CA_ST_STG9");
				if (!_bIsEngineRun || !num.HasValue || num <= 0 || num >= 99999999)
				{
					num = IntVal(_contextMainPath, _contextOption, section, "Input.CA_STAGE1");
				}
				if (num.HasValue)
				{
					cASectionRange.StartStageNumber = num.Value;
				}
				num = IntVal(_contextMainPath, _contextOption, section, "Output.CA_END_STG9");
				if (!_bIsEngineRun || !num.HasValue || num <= 0 || num >= 99999999)
				{
					num = IntVal(_contextMainPath, _contextOption, section, "Input.CA_STAGE2");
				}
				if (num.HasValue)
				{
					cASectionRange.EndStageNumber = num.Value;
				}
				cASectionRange.StageType = GetStageType(section);
				string text = sConfigOption + ".Subobjects.Sections." + section;
				bool value = true;
				if (_cxsCase.InvokeAction("Top.appModelV8.Custom Actions", "HappNode", new object[1] { text }) is IHNode iHNode)
				{
					if (((HAPCompStatusCode)(dynamic)iHNode.get_AttributeValue((short)12, (object)null) & HAPCompStatusCode.HAP_INPUT_INCOMPLETE) == HAPCompStatusCode.HAP_INPUT_INCOMPLETE)
					{
						value = false;
					}
					cASectionRange.IsCompleteStatus = value;
				}
				list.Add(cASectionRange);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static int AddToList(ref string sMMVars, string sVar, ref string sValues, object oValue, ref int nKnt)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			bool flag = false;
			if (oValue == null)
			{
				return nKnt;
			}
			if (oValue.GetType() != typeof(string))
			{
				if (oValue.GetType() == typeof(int))
				{
					if (int.TryParse(oValue.ToString(), out var result) && (result < 0 || result >= 99999999))
					{
						return nKnt;
					}
				}
				else if (oValue.GetType() == typeof(double))
				{
					double? num = oValue as double?;
					if (num.HasValue)
					{
						if (num >= 1E+35)
						{
							return nKnt;
						}
						flag = true;
						text = num.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
						if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
						{
							flag = false;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			string text2 = (flag ? text : oValue.ToString());
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
			{
				return nKnt;
			}
			if (text2.IndexOf(' ') != -1)
			{
				text2 = text2.Split(' ')[0];
			}
			if (string.Empty == sMMVars)
			{
				sMMVars = sVar;
				sValues = text2;
			}
			else
			{
				sMMVars = sMMVars + ";" + sVar;
				sValues = sValues + ";" + text2;
			}
			return nKnt++;
		}

		public static bool RunWithHydraulicFlagOn(string contextblockPath, CxsDataProvider dataProvider)
		{
			int? num = MmgSor.MMinqrsl();
			int? num2 = MmgSor.MMinqcpt();
			int? num3 = MmgSor.MMinqpgc();
			int num4 = MmgSor.MMinqnec();
			int num5 = MmgSor.MMinqautorun();
			MmgSor.MMsetautorun(0);
			string hydraulicReport = GetHydraulicReport(contextblockPath, dataProvider);
			bool flag = false;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(hydraulicReport) && string.Compare(hydraulicReport, "NOHYDRAULIC", ignoreCase: true) == 0)
			{
				SetHydraulicReport(contextblockPath, dataProvider, "HYDRAULIC");
				flag = true;
			}
			if (_runDialog_Numberoftimes_shown > 0)
			{
				_runDialog_Numberoftimes_shown = 0;
			}
			bool result = NeedsToRunSimulationFirst(contextblockPath, dataProvider);
			if (flag)
			{
				SetHydraulicReport(contextblockPath, dataProvider, "NOHYDRAULIC");
				if (num.HasValue)
				{
					MmgSor.MMsetrsl(num.Value);
				}
				if (num2.HasValue)
				{
					MmgSor.MMsetcpt(num2.Value);
				}
				if (num3.HasValue)
				{
					MmgSor.MMsetpgc(num3.Value);
				}
				MmgSor.MMsetnec(num4);
			}
			MmgSor.MMsetautorun(num5);
			if (bUserChoseNotToRun)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static string AddLinebreaksIntoString(string str, int nMaxLength)
		{
			string[] array = str.Replace("Tray", "Stage").Split(' ');
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			StringBuilder stringBuilder2 = new StringBuilder();
			string[] array2 = array;
			foreach (string text in array2)
			{
				if (stringBuilder2.Length + text.Length < nMaxLength - 1)
				{
					if (stringBuilder2.Length == 0)
					{
						stringBuilder2.AppendFormat("{0}", text);
					}
					else
					{
						stringBuilder2.AppendFormat(" {0}", text);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(stringBuilder2);
					stringBuilder.AppendLine();
					stringBuilder2.Clear();
					stringBuilder2.AppendFormat("{0}", text);
				}
			}
			stringBuilder.Append(stringBuilder2);
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public static void LoopThroughAllHierarchies(AcsBaseRecord rec, List<string> radfracBlkList)
		{
			AcsFlowsheet val = (AcsFlowsheet)(object)((rec is AcsFlowsheet) ? rec : null);
			if (val == null || val.Blocks == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int length = ((AcsArrayBase)val.Blocks).Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				AcsBlock val2 = val.Blocks.ValueAtLocation(i);
				if (val2 == null || ((AcsBaseRecord)val2).Record == null || val2.SubFlowsheets == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				string text = ((AcsBase)val2).ObjectType();
				if (((ValueArray<string, AcsFlowsheet>)(object)val2.SubFlowsheets).FindID("Simulation") != -1 && string.Compare(((AcsBase)val2).ObjectType(), "Hierarchy") == 0)
				{
					AcsFlowsheet val3 = val2.SubFlowsheets.ValueAt("Simulation");
					if (val3 != null && ((AcsBaseRecord)val3).Record != null)
					{
						LoopThroughAllHierarchies((AcsBaseRecord)(object)val3, radfracBlkList);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					string.IsNullOrEmpty(text);
					if (string.Equals(text, "APRadFrac", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && (radfracBlkList == null || radfracBlkList.Contains(val2.ID)))
					{
						((AcsBase)val2).CastTo<AcsColumn>().RemoveAllOptions();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		}

		public static void WritePackingResultsToDBS(CxsDataProvider dataProvider, string sFullblockName, string sOptionId, string sSectionKey, CAPackingSectionResults packingSectionData)
		{
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0050: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0048: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_017d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0187: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_01b7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01be: Expected O, but got Unknown
			AcsColumn aCSColumnBlock = GetACSColumnBlock(sFullblockName);
			if (aCSColumnBlock == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IAdbTop activeDocAdbTop = MmgSor.GetActiveDocAdbTop();
			AcsOptionTraySectionResultData val = null;
			bool flag = false;
			if (((ValueArray<string, AcsOptionTraySectionResultData>)(object)aCSColumnBlock.CAOptionResult).FindID(sOptionId) != -1)
			{
				val = aCSColumnBlock.CAOptionResult.ValueAt(sOptionId);
				if (val != null)
				{
					aCSColumnBlock.RemoveCAOptionSection(sOptionId, sSectionKey);
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (val == null)
			{
				val = new AcsOptionTraySectionResultData(activeDocAdbTop);
			}
			AcsPackSectionResultData sectionResultdata = new AcsPackSectionResultData(activeDocAdbTop);
			PopulatePackSectionResultData(packingSectionData, ref sectionResultdata);
			string text = sFullblockName;
			text = text.Replace(".", ".Data.Blocks.");
			string text2 = "Top.appModelV8.Blocks." + text + ".Output.";
			double? num = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(dataProvider.Case.BatchGet(text2 + "RATE_PRDIAM." + sOptionId + "." + sSectionKey, "value", "meter"));
			if (num.HasValue && num.HasValue)
			{
				string text3 = MMStringVal(sFullblockName, sOptionId, sSectionKey, "OPT-CA-BASE");
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3) && text3 == "YES")
				{
					sectionResultdata.RateBasedDiameter = num.Value;
				}
			}
			_ = sFullblockName + "-" + sOptionId + "-" + sSectionKey;
			string innerXml = packingSectionData.GetXmlDocument().InnerXml;
			string innerXml2 = packingSectionData.PackingDiagramSectionData.GetXmlDocument().InnerXml;
			sectionResultdata.SectionResultDataXML = innerXml;
			sectionResultdata.DiagramSectionDataXML = innerXml2;
			val.CAPackSectionResult.Append(sSectionKey, sectionResultdata);
			sectionResultdata.HydraulicResults = new AcsColumnAnalysisProfile(activeDocAdbTop);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, CAPackingHydraulicData> hydraulicResult in packingSectionData.HydraulicResults)
			{
				int key = hydraulicResult.Key;
				CAPackingHydraulicData value = hydraulicResult.Value;
				if (value != null)
				{
					AcsColumnAnalysisStage caStage = new AcsColumnAnalysisStage(activeDocAdbTop);
					PopulatePackHydraulicStageProfile(key, value, ref caStage);
					sectionResultdata.HydraulicResults.CAStageHydraulicValues.Append(key, caStage);
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				aCSColumnBlock.CAOptionResult.Append(sOptionId, val);
			}
		}

		public static void PopulateMDDowncomer(TraySectionResultData traySectionData, ref AcsCAMDDowncomerResultData caMDDowncomer)

			}
		}

		public static string GetDescriptionAttribute(Enum value)
		{
			if (Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(value.GetType().GetField(value.ToString()), typeof(DescriptionAttribute)) is DescriptionAttribute descriptionAttribute)
			{
				return descriptionAttribute.Description;
			}
			return value.ToString();
		}

		{

		public static void CAUnregisterSection(IUnityContainer unityContainer, string sFullBlockPath, string sOptionId, string sSectionId)
		{
			AcsColumn aCSColumnBlock = GetACSColumnBlock(sFullBlockPath.Contains(";") ? sFullBlockPath.Split(';')[1] : sFullBlockPath);
			if (aCSColumnBlock == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = sFullBlockPath;
			text = text.Replace(".", ".Data.Blocks.");
			string columnKey = "Top.appModelV8.Blocks." + text;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(sOptionId))
			{
				text = "Top.appModelV8.Blocks." + text + ".Subobjects.Column Internals." + sOptionId;
			}
			IColumnAnalyzerModel columnAnalyzerModel = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IColumnAnalyzerModel>(unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (columnAnalyzerModel == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sSectionId) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(sOptionId))
			{
				string[] array = sOptionId.Split(';');
				if (array.Count() > 1)
				{
					CARenameOption(unityContainer, sFullBlockPath, array[0], array[1]);
					return;
				}
				if (((ValueArray<string, AcsOptionTraySectionResultData>)(object)aCSColumnBlock.CAOptionResult).FindID(sOptionId) != -1)
				{
					aCSColumnBlock.RemoveCAResult(sOptionId);
				}
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(sSectionId) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(sOptionId))
			{
				string[] array2 = sSectionId.Split(';');
				if (array2.Count() > 1)
				{
					((ValueArray<string, AcsOptionTraySectionResultData>)(object)aCSColumnBlock.CAOptionResult).FindID(sOptionId);
					_ = -1;
					columnAnalyzerModel.RefreshHydraulicPlot(CARefreshEnum.SectionDeleted, columnKey, text, array2[0]);
					return;
				}
				if (((ValueArray<string, AcsOptionTraySectionResultData>)(object)aCSColumnBlock.CAOptionResult).FindID(sOptionId) != -1)
				{
					aCSColumnBlock.RemoveCAOptionSection(sOptionId, sSectionId);
				}
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sSectionId) && string.IsNullOrEmpty(sOptionId))
			{
				string[] array3 = sFullBlockPath.Split(';');
				if (array3.Count() > 1)
				{
					CARenameColumn(unityContainer, array3[0], array3[1]);
					return;
				}
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sOptionId))
			{
				columnAnalyzerModel.RefreshHydraulicPlot(CARefreshEnum.ColumnDeleted, columnKey, "");
			}
			else if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sSectionId))
			{
				columnAnalyzerModel.RefreshHydraulicPlot(CARefreshEnum.OptionDeleted, columnKey, text);
			}
			else
			{
				columnAnalyzerModel.RefreshHydraulicPlot(CARefreshEnum.SectionDeleted, columnKey, text, sSectionId);
			}
		}

		}

		public static int CACheckSectionReqInputComplete(IUnityContainer unityContainer, string sFullBlockPath, string sOptionId, string sSectionId)
		{
			ISimulatorCADataProvider simulatorCADataProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (simulatorCADataProvider == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}

			text = "Top.appModelV8.Blocks." + text + ".Subobjects.Column Internals." + sOptionId;
			SimSectionDataBase simSectionData = simulatorCADataProvider.GetSimSectionData(text, sSectionId);

		}

		public TraySectionResultData GetTraySectionResultData(string sConfigOption, string sectionKey)
		{
			int num = sConfigOption.IndexOf("Subobjects.Column Internals");
			string text = sConfigOption.Substring(0, num - 1);
			int startIndex = sConfigOption.IndexOf(sColumnInternal) + sColumnInternal.Length + 1;
			string text2 = sConfigOption.Substring(startIndex);
			IHNode iHNode = _cxsCase.InvokeAction("Top.appModelV8.Custom Actions", "HappNode", new object[1] { text }) as IHNode;
			string text3 = string.Empty;
			if (iHNode != null)
			{
				text3 = (dynamic)iHNode.get_AttributeValue((short)65, Type.Missing);
			}
			AcsColumn aCSColumnBlock = GetACSColumnBlock(text3);
			if (aCSColumnBlock == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			AcsOptionTraySectionResultData val = aCSColumnBlock.CAOptionResult.ValueAt(text2);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			AcsTraySectionResultData val2 = val.CASectionResult.ValueAt(sectionKey);
			if (val2 == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			XmlDocument xmlDocument = new XmlDocument();
			string text4 = val2.SectionResultDataXML;
			if (text4 == null)
			{
				string key = text3 + "-" + text2 + "-" + sectionKey;
				if (_dictxmlstring_TraySectionResultData.ContainsKey(key))
				{
					text4 = _dictxmlstring_TraySectionResultData[key];
				}
			}
			TraySectionResultData traySectionResultData = null;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text4))
			{
				traySectionResultData = MannulCreateTraySectionResults(val2, sConfigOption, sectionKey);
			}
			else
			{
				xmlDocument.LoadXml(text4);
			}
			XmlDocument xmlDocument2 = new XmlDocument();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(val2.DiagramSectionDataXML))
			{
				xmlDocument2.LoadXml(val2.DiagramSectionDataXML);
				DiagramSectionData diagramSectionData = CADataHelper.DiagramSectionDataDeSerialize(xmlDocument2);
				traySectionResultData = CADataHelper.TraySectionResultDataDeSerialize(xmlDocument);
				traySectionResultData.DiagramSectionData = diagramSectionData;
			}
			return traySectionResultData;
		}

		public IList<CAOption> GetColumnOptions(string columnKey)
		{
			List<CAOption> list = new List<CAOption>();
			string text = $"{columnKey}.Subobjects.Column Internals";
			if (_cxsCase == null)
			{
				_cxsCase = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<CxsCase>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			}
			if (_cxsCase != null)
			{
				Collection<string> collection = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(_cxsCase.BatchGet(text, "child_ids"));
				if (collection != null && collection.Count > 0)
				{
					bool isActiveOption = false;
					bool flag = false;
					foreach (string item in collection)
					{
						if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(item))
						{
							continue;
						}
						if (!flag)
						{
							string text2 = text + "." + item + ".Input.CA_ACTIVE1." + item;
							if (_cxsCase.InvokeAction("Top.appModelV8.Custom Actions", "HappNode", new object[1] { text2 }) is IHNode iHNode && string.Equals((dynamic)iHNode.get_AttributeValue((short)0, Type.Missing), "YES", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
							{
								flag = true;
								isActiveOption = true;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							isActiveOption = false;
						}
						list.Add(new CAOption(item, $"{text}.{item}", isActiveOption));
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public string GetDefaultExportFilePath()
		{
			if (_cxsCase == null)
			{
				_cxsCase = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<CxsCase>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			}
			return _cxsCase.CaseFilePath;
		}

		public string GetCurrentCaseName()
		{
			if (_cxsCase == null)
			{
				_cxsCase = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<CxsCase>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			}
			return _cxsCase.CaseFileName.Replace(".bkp", string.Empty).Replace(".apw", string.Empty).Replace(".apt", string.Empty)
				.Replace(".inp", string.Empty)
				.Replace(".apwz", string.Empty)
				.Replace(".apm", string.Empty);
		}

		public CAOption GetColumnOption(string sOptionKey)
		{
			int startIndex = sOptionKey.IndexOf(sColumnInternal) + sColumnInternal.Length + 1;
			string text = sOptionKey.Substring(startIndex);
			bool isActiveOption = false;
			if (string.Equals(MMStringVal(FullColumnName, text, "", "CA-ACTIVE1"), "YES", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				isActiveOption = true;
			}
			CAOption cAOption = new CAOption(text, sOptionKey, isActiveOption);
			string text2 = MMStringVal(FullColumnName, text, "", "CA-STATIC-DP");
			cAOption.IncludeStaticVaporHeadPDCalc = false;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2) && string.Compare(text2, "YES", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				cAOption.IncludeStaticVaporHeadPDCalc = true;
			}
			text2 = MMStringVal(FullColumnName, text, "", "CA-SUMP-BSTG");
			cAOption.MakeBottomStageSump = false;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2) && string.Compare(text2, "YES", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				cAOption.MakeBottomStageSump = true;
			}
			double? num = MMDoubleVal(FullColumnName, text, "", "CA-SUMP-DIAM");
			if (num.HasValue)
			{
				cAOption.SumpDiameter.Value = num.Value;
				bool? flag = HelperFuncs.SMRadCA_GetOptionVarUserEntFlagMM(FullColumnName, text, "CA-SUMP-DIAM");
				if (flag.HasValue && flag.HasValue && flag.Value)
				{
					cAOption.SumpDiameter.VariableStatus = VariableStatusEnum.Input;
				}
			}
			int num2 = 0;
			text2 = MMStringVal(FullColumnName, text, "", "CA-OPT-SUMP");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2) && string.Compare(text2, "LEVEL", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				num2 = 1;
			}
			if (num2 == 0)
			{
				num = MMDoubleVal(FullColumnName, text, "", "CA-LIQ-RTIME");
				if (num.HasValue)
				{
					cAOption.SumpLiquidResidenceTime.Value = num.Value;
					bool? flag2 = HelperFuncs.SMRadCA_GetOptionVarUserEntFlagMM(FullColumnName, text, "CA-LIQ-RTIME");
					if (flag2.HasValue && flag2.HasValue && flag2.Value)
					{
						cAOption.SumpLiquidResidenceTime.VariableStatus = VariableStatusEnum.Input;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num = MMDoubleVal(FullColumnName, text, "", "CA-LIQ-LEVEL");
				if (num.HasValue)
				{
					cAOption.SumpLiquidLevel.Value = num.Value;
					bool? flag3 = HelperFuncs.SMRadCA_GetOptionVarUserEntFlagMM(FullColumnName, text, "CA-LIQ-LEVEL");
					if (flag3.HasValue && flag3.HasValue && flag3.Value)
					{
						cAOption.SumpLiquidLevel.VariableStatus = VariableStatusEnum.Input;
					}
				}
			}
			string text3 = "Top.appModel.Setup.Sim-Options.Input.PACKING_DB";
			string strDB = CxsConverter.ValueToString(_cxsCase.BatchGet(text3, "value", (string)null));
			cAOption.PackingDB.Value = GetPackingDBValue(strDB);
			return cAOption;
		}

		public bool WriteTemplateData(SimSectionDataBase sectionData, string configOptionKey, string sectionKey)
		{
			//IL_104b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0ccf: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0cd6: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0e07: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0e0e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0d21: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0e40: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SetContexts(configOptionKey);
			string text = IsTrayedorPacked(_contextOption, sectionKey);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = configOptionKey.LastIndexOf(".");
			string text2 = configOptionKey.Substring(num + 1);
			CxsDataProvider val = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<CxsDataProvider>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (val == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (text == "TRAY" && sectionData is CATraySectionData)
			{
				CATraySectionData cATraySectionData = sectionData as CATraySectionData;
				if (cATraySectionData.IsCustomTray ?? false)
				{
					SaveDiameterToAPlusForCustomTray(cATraySectionData.Diameter, "CA_DIAM", configOptionKey, text2, sectionKey, val);
				}
				else
				{

				}

				if (!cATraySectionData.IsMDTray.Value)
				{

					if (cATraySectionData.SweptBackType.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)

							value = "KG-TOWER";

					SaveCAVariableValueToAPlus(cATraySectionData.SweptBackDimensionSF, "CA_SW_SF", configOptionKey, text2, sectionKey, val);

					string value2 = "NO";
					if (cATraySectionData.SweptBackENAB.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && cATraySectionData.SweptBackENAB.Value == 1)

					}

			else
			{
				if (!(text == "PACKING") || !(sectionData is CAPackingSectionData))
				{
					MMMessageBox.Show(ApwnResources.ColumnInternalImportTemplateMsg, ApwnResources.ColumnInternalImportTemplateTitle, (MMMessageBoxButton)0, (MMMessageBoxImage)48, false, 1, "apwn.chm", -1);
					return false;
				}
				CAPackingSectionData cAPackingSectionData = sectionData as CAPackingSectionData;

		private string GetAspenPlusTrayTypeString(ValveTrayLayout trayLayout)
		{
			if (trayLayout is KochFlexitrayValveTrayLayout)
			{
				KochFlexitrayValveTrayLayout kochFlexitrayValveTrayLayout = trayLayout as KochFlexitrayValveTrayLayout;
				return ("FLEX-" + kochFlexitrayValveTrayLayout.KochValveType.EnumString).ToUpper();
			}
			if (trayLayout is NutterFloatValveTrayLayout)
			{
				NutterFloatValveTrayLayout nutterFloatValveTrayLayout = trayLayout as NutterFloatValveTrayLayout;
				return ("NUTTER-" + nutterFloatValveTrayLayout.NutterValveType.EnumString).ToUpper();
			}
			if (trayLayout is GlitschBallastValveTrayLayout)
			{
				GlitschBallastValveTrayLayout glitschBallastValveTrayLayout = trayLayout as GlitschBallastValveTrayLayout;
				return ("BALLAST-" + glitschBallastValveTrayLayout.GlitschValveType.EnumString).ToUpper();
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void WriteValveTrayLayoutToAplus(ValveTrayLayout trayLayout, string configOptionKey, string optionKey, string sectionKey, CxsDataProvider dataProvider)
		{
			SaveCAVariableValueToAPlus(trayLayout.ValveMaterial, "CA_VALVE_MAT", configOptionKey, optionKey, sectionKey, dataProvider, saveEnumString: true);
			SaveCAVariableValueToAPlus(trayLayout.ValveLift, "CA_VALVE_LFT", configOptionKey, optionKey, sectionKey, dataProvider, saveEnumString: true);
			SaveCAVariableValueToAPlus(trayLayout.ValveThickness, "CA_VALVE_TCK", configOptionKey, optionKey, sectionKey, dataProvider, saveEnumString: true);
			SaveCAVariableValueToAPlus(trayLayout.NumberOfValves, "CA_NVALVES", configOptionKey, optionKey, sectionKey, dataProvider);
			SaveCAVariableValueToAPlus(trayLayout.NumberOfValvesToActiveArea, "CA_VALVE_DEN", configOptionKey, optionKey, sectionKey, dataProvider);
		}

		private static string FormatVariablePath(string configOptionKey, string optionkey, string sectionKey, string variableName)
		{

		}
