		public bool CreateNewSection(string configOptionKey, string internalType, out string createdId)
		{
			createdId = null;
			CxsDataProvider val = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<CxsDataProvider>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (val == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			val.UpdateDataCache();
			string text = configOptionKey + ".Subobjects.Sections";
			string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(val.BatchGet(text, "default_name", (string)null));
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2) && val.InvokeAction(text, "InsertChild", true, new object[1] { text2 }).Succeeded)
			{
				createdId = text2;
				if (internalType.Equals("Packing", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					int num = configOptionKey.LastIndexOf(".");
					string optionkey = configOptionKey.Substring(num + 1);
					string text3 = FormatVariablePath(configOptionKey, optionkey, createdId, "CA_INTERNAL");
					return val.BatchSet(text3, "value", (string)null, (object)"PACKING");
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool ChangeInternalType(string configOptionKey, string sectionKey, string internalType)
		{
			CxsDataProvider val = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<CxsDataProvider>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (val == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = configOptionKey.LastIndexOf(".");
			string optionkey = configOptionKey.Substring(num + 1);
			string text = "TRAY";
			if (internalType.Equals("Packing", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				text = "PACKING";
			}
			string text2 = FormatVariablePath(configOptionKey, optionkey, sectionKey, "CA_INTERNAL");
			return val.BatchSet(text2, "value", (string)null, (object)text);
		}

		public CAPackingSectionResults GetPackingSectionResultData(string sConfigOptionKey, string sectionKey)
		{
			int num = sConfigOptionKey.IndexOf("Subobjects.Column Internals");
			string text = sConfigOptionKey.Substring(0, num - 1);
			int startIndex = sConfigOptionKey.IndexOf(sColumnInternal) + sColumnInternal.Length + 1;
			string text2 = sConfigOptionKey.Substring(startIndex);
			IHNode iHNode = _cxsCase.InvokeAction("Top.appModelV8.Custom Actions", "HappNode", new object[1] { text }) as IHNode;
			string sFullblockName = string.Empty;
			if (iHNode != null)
			{
				sFullblockName = (dynamic)iHNode.get_AttributeValue((short)65, Type.Missing);
			}
			AcsColumn aCSColumnBlock = GetACSColumnBlock(sFullblockName);
			if (aCSColumnBlock == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			AcsOptionTraySectionResultData val = aCSColumnBlock.CAOptionResult.ValueAt(text2);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			AcsPackSectionResultData val2 = val.CAPackSectionResult.ValueAt(sectionKey);
			if (val2 == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			XmlDocument xmlDocument = new XmlDocument();
			string sectionResultDataXML = val2.SectionResultDataXML;
			CAPackingSectionResults cAPackingSectionResults = null;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sectionResultDataXML))
			{
				return MannulCreateCAPackingSectionResults(val2, sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey);
			}
			xmlDocument.LoadXml(sectionResultDataXML);
			return CADataHelper.PackSectionResultDataDeSerialize(xmlDocument);
		}

		private CAPackingSectionResults MannulCreateCAPackingSectionResults(AcsPackSectionResultData adsSctionResultdata, string sConfigOptionKey, string sectionKey)
		{
			ColumnInternalsData columnInternalsData = GetColumnInternalsData(sConfigOptionKey);
			CAPackingSectionResults cAPackingSectionResults = new CAPackingSectionResults();
			if (adsSctionResultdata.SectionKey != null)
			{
				cAPackingSectionResults.SectionKey = adsSctionResultdata.SectionKey;
			}
			if (adsSctionResultdata.SectionName != null)
			{
				cAPackingSectionResults.SectionName = adsSctionResultdata.SectionName;
			}
			if (adsSctionResultdata.StartStageNumber.HasValue)
			{
				cAPackingSectionResults.StartStageNumber.Value = adsSctionResultdata.StartStageNumber.Value;
			}
			if (adsSctionResultdata.EndStageNumber.HasValue)
			{
				cAPackingSectionResults.EndtStageNumber.Value = adsSctionResultdata.EndStageNumber.Value;
			}
			if (adsSctionResultdata.Diameter.HasValue)
			{
				cAPackingSectionResults.Diameter.Value = adsSctionResultdata.Diameter.Value;
			}
			if (adsSctionResultdata.HETP.HasValue)
			{
				cAPackingSectionResults.HETP.Value = adsSctionResultdata.HETP.Value;
			}
			if (adsSctionResultdata.SectionPackingHeight.HasValue)
			{
				cAPackingSectionResults.PackingHeight.Value = adsSctionResultdata.SectionPackingHeight.Value;
			}
			if (adsSctionResultdata.MaximumCapacityFactor.HasValue)
			{
				cAPackingSectionResults.MaximumCapacityFactor.Value = adsSctionResultdata.MaximumCapacityFactor.Value;
			}
			if (adsSctionResultdata.MaximumFractionalCapacity.HasValue)
			{
				cAPackingSectionResults.MaximumFractionalCapacity.Value = adsSctionResultdata.MaximumFractionalCapacity.Value;
			}
			if (adsSctionResultdata.MaximumFractionalCapacityL.HasValue)
			{
				cAPackingSectionResults.MaximumFractionalCapacityL.Value = adsSctionResultdata.MaximumFractionalCapacityL.Value;
			}
			if (adsSctionResultdata.MaximumFsBasedOnNetArea.HasValue)
			{
				cAPackingSectionResults.MaximumFsBasedOnNetArea.Value = adsSctionResultdata.MaximumFsBasedOnNetArea.Value;
			}
			if (adsSctionResultdata.MaximumApproachToSystemLimit.HasValue)
			{
				cAPackingSectionResults.MaximumApproachToSystemLimit.Value = adsSctionResultdata.MaximumApproachToSystemLimit.Value;
			}
			if (adsSctionResultdata.SectionPressureDrop.HasValue)
			{
				cAPackingSectionResults.SectionPressureDrop.Value = adsSctionResultdata.SectionPressureDrop.Value;
			}
			if (adsSctionResultdata.AveragePressureDropPerHeight.HasValue)
			{
				cAPackingSectionResults.AveragePressureDropPerHeight.Value = adsSctionResultdata.AveragePressureDropPerHeight.Value;
			}
			if (adsSctionResultdata.AveragePressureDropPerHeightFrictional.HasValue)
			{
				cAPackingSectionResults.AveragePressureDropPerHeightFrictional.Value = adsSctionResultdata.AveragePressureDropPerHeightFrictional.Value;
			}
			if (adsSctionResultdata.MaximumStageLiquidHoldup.HasValue)
			{
				cAPackingSectionResults.MaximumStageLiquidHoldup.Value = adsSctionResultdata.MaximumStageLiquidHoldup.Value;
			}
			if (adsSctionResultdata.MaxLliquidSuperficialVelocity.HasValue)
			{
				cAPackingSectionResults.MaxLliquidSuperficialVelocity.Value = adsSctionResultdata.MaxLliquidSuperficialVelocity.Value;
			}
			if (adsSctionResultdata.StichlmairSurfaceArea.HasValue)
			{
				cAPackingSectionResults.StichlmairSurfaceArea.Value = adsSctionResultdata.StichlmairSurfaceArea.Value;
			}
			if (adsSctionResultdata.StichlmairVoidFraction.HasValue)
			{
				cAPackingSectionResults.StichlmairVoidFraction.Value = adsSctionResultdata.StichlmairVoidFraction.Value;
			}
			if (adsSctionResultdata.StichlmairConstant_1.HasValue)
			{
				cAPackingSectionResults.StichlmairConstant_1.Value = adsSctionResultdata.StichlmairConstant_1.Value;
			}
			if (adsSctionResultdata.StichlmairConstant_2.HasValue)
			{
				cAPackingSectionResults.StichlmairConstant_2.Value = adsSctionResultdata.StichlmairConstant_2.Value;
			}
			if (adsSctionResultdata.StichlmairConstant_3.HasValue)
			{
				cAPackingSectionResults.StichlmairConstant_3.Value = adsSctionResultdata.StichlmairConstant_3.Value;
			}
			if (adsSctionResultdata.StichlmairFFmin.HasValue)
			{
				cAPackingSectionResults.StichlmairFFmin.Value = adsSctionResultdata.StichlmairFFmin.Value;
			}
			if (adsSctionResultdata.MaximumFloodingPercent.HasValue)
			{
				cAPackingSectionResults.MaximumFloodingPercent.Value = adsSctionResultdata.MaximumFloodingPercent.Value;
			}
			if (adsSctionResultdata.CrossSectionArea.HasValue)
			{
				cAPackingSectionResults.CrossSectionArea.Value = adsSctionResultdata.CrossSectionArea.Value;
			}
			if (adsSctionResultdata.PackLimitingStage >= cAPackingSectionResults.StartStageNumber.Value && adsSctionResultdata.PackLimitingStage <= cAPackingSectionResults.EndtStageNumber.Value)
			{
				cAPackingSectionResults.TrayNumberWithMaxFlooding.Value = adsSctionResultdata.PackLimitingStage;
			}
			if (adsSctionResultdata.TotalPressureDrop_HeadLoss.HasValue)
			{
				cAPackingSectionResults.TotalPressureDrop_HeadLoss.Value = adsSctionResultdata.TotalPressureDrop_HeadLoss.Value;
			}
			if (!cAPackingSectionResults.EndtStageNumber.IsEmpty() && !cAPackingSectionResults.StartStageNumber.IsEmpty())
			{
				int num = cAPackingSectionResults.EndtStageNumber.Value - cAPackingSectionResults.StartStageNumber.Value + 1;
				int num2 = cAPackingSectionResults.StartStageNumber.Value;
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					AcsColumnAnalysisStage val = adsSctionResultdata.HydraulicResults.CAStageHydraulicValues.ValueAt(num2);
					if (val != null)
					{
						CAPackingHydraulicData cAPackingHydraulicData = new CAPackingHydraulicData(columnInternalsData.Stages[num2 - 1]);
						PopulatePackHydraulicStageProfile(num2, val, cAPackingHydraulicData);
						cAPackingSectionResults.HydraulicResults.Add(num2, cAPackingHydraulicData);
					}
					num2++;
				}
			}
			return cAPackingSectionResults;
		}

		public void PopulatePackHydraulicStageProfile(int stageNumber, AcsColumnAnalysisStage adsPackHydraulic, CAPackingHydraulicData caStage)
		{
			if (adsPackHydraulic != null && caStage != null)
			{
				caStage.TrayNumber.Value = stageNumber;
				if (adsPackHydraulic.StagePackHeight.HasValue)
				{
					caStage.StagePackHeight.Value = adsPackHydraulic.StagePackHeight.Value;
				}
				if (adsPackHydraulic.StageFractionalCapacity.HasValue)
				{
					caStage.StageFractionalCapacity.Value = adsPackHydraulic.StageFractionalCapacity.Value;
				}
				if (adsPackHydraulic.StageHETP.HasValue)
				{
					caStage.StageHETP.Value = adsPackHydraulic.StageHETP.Value;
				}
				if (adsPackHydraulic.StagePressureDrop.HasValue)
				{
					caStage.StagePressureDrop.Value = adsPackHydraulic.StagePressureDrop.Value;
				}
				if (adsPackHydraulic.StagePressureDropPerHeight.HasValue)
				{
					caStage.StagePressureDropPerHeight.Value = adsPackHydraulic.StagePressureDropPerHeight.Value;
				}
				if (adsPackHydraulic.StageLiquidHoldUp.HasValue)
				{
					caStage.StageLiquidHoldUp.Value = adsPackHydraulic.StageLiquidHoldUp.Value;
				}
				if (adsPackHydraulic.StageLiquidVelocity.HasValue)
				{
					caStage.StageLiquidVelocity.Value = adsPackHydraulic.StageLiquidVelocity.Value;
				}
				if (adsPackHydraulic.FsBasedOnNetArea.HasValue)
				{
					caStage.Fs.Value = adsPackHydraulic.FsBasedOnNetArea.Value;
				}
				if (adsPackHydraulic.CsBasedOnNetArea.HasValue)
				{
					caStage.Cs.Value = adsPackHydraulic.CsBasedOnNetArea.Value;
				}
				if (adsPackHydraulic.ApproachToSystemLimit.HasValue)
				{
					caStage.ApproachToSystemLimit.Value = adsPackHydraulic.ApproachToSystemLimit.Value;
				}
				if (adsPackHydraulic.ApproachToFloodLV.HasValue)
				{
					caStage.ApproachToFloodLV.Value = adsPackHydraulic.ApproachToFloodLV.Value;
				}
				if (adsPackHydraulic.ApproachToFloodL.HasValue)
				{
					caStage.ApproachToFloodL.Value = adsPackHydraulic.ApproachToFloodL.Value;
				}
				if (adsPackHydraulic.LiquidFilmNumber.HasValue)
				{
					caStage.Cl.Value = adsPackHydraulic.LiquidFilmNumber.Value;
				}
			}
		}

			{
				int num = traySectionResultData.EndtStageNumber.Value - traySectionResultData.StartStageNumber.Value + 1;
				int num2 = traySectionResultData.StartStageNumber.Value;
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					AcsColumnAnalysisStage val = adsSctionResultdata.HydraulicResults.CAStageHydraulicValues.ValueAt(num2);
					if (val != null)
					{
						TrayHydraulicPerformance trayHydraulicPerformance = new TrayHydraulicPerformance(columnInternalsData.Stages[num2 - 1]);
						PopulateHydraulicStageProfile(num2, val, trayHydraulicPerformance);
						traySectionResultData.HydraulicResults.Add(num2, trayHydraulicPerformance);
					}
					num2++;
				}
			}
			return traySectionResultData;

		public CAColumnInternalResults GetColumnInternalLevelResultData(string configOptionKey)
		{
			int num = configOptionKey.IndexOf("Subobjects.Column Internals");
			string text = configOptionKey.Substring(0, num - 1);
			int startIndex = configOptionKey.IndexOf(sColumnInternal) + sColumnInternal.Length + 1;
			string text2 = configOptionKey.Substring(startIndex);
			IHNode iHNode = _cxsCase.InvokeAction("Top.appModelV8.Custom Actions", "HappNode", new object[1] { text }) as IHNode;
			string sFullblockName = string.Empty;
			if (iHNode != null)
			{
				sFullblockName = (dynamic)iHNode.get_AttributeValue((short)65, Type.Missing);
			}
			AcsColumn aCSColumnBlock = GetACSColumnBlock(sFullblockName);
			if (aCSColumnBlock == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			AcsOptionTraySectionResultData val = aCSColumnBlock.CAOptionResult.ValueAt(text2);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			XmlDocument xmlDocument = new XmlDocument();
			string columnInternalDataXML = val.ColumnInternalDataXML;
			xmlDocument.LoadXml(columnInternalDataXML);
			return CADataHelper.ColumnInternalResultDataDeSerialize(xmlDocument);
		}

		public static int GetPackingDBValue(string strDB)
		{
			return strDB switch
			{
				"LATEST" => 0, 
				"V2006" => 1, 
				"V2006.5" => 2, 
				"V7" => 3, 
				"V7.2" => 4, 
				"V9.0" => 5, 
				_ => 0, 
			};
		}
	}

	public class BatchSepColumnInternalsViewModel : MMTabPageViewModel
	{
		protected override void OnViewUpdateDisplayEvent()
		{
			string text = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main");
			int num = text.LastIndexOf(".Blocks.");
			if (num <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num2 = text.IndexOf('.', num + 8);
			if (num2 < 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text2 = text.Substring(0, num2) + ".CC Nodes.CONFG8";
			if (!(CxsConverter.ValueToBoolean(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(text2, "value")) ?? false))
			{
				object view = ((MMViewModel)this).View;
				MMTabTemplate val = (MMTabTemplate)((view is MMTabTemplate) ? view : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					((MMViewModelContainer)val).CloseHostScreenControl();
				}
			}
			((MMViewModel)this).OnViewUpdateDisplayEvent();
		}
	}

		private void _diagram_DataDragStarting(object sender, DataDragStartingEventArgs e)
		{
			e.Handled = true;
			string caseFullFilePath = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.Case.CaseFullFilePath;
			IDataObject dataObject = e.DataObject;
			MemoryStream asiFileXml = ClipboardHelper.GetAsiFileXml(caseFullFilePath, ((MMViewModel)this).GetProductName());
			if (asiFileXml != null)
			{
				dataObject.SetData(DataFormats.GetDataFormat("ASI File Format").Name, asiFileXml);
			}
			string asiSelectionXml = ClipboardHelper.GetAsiSelectionXml((ICollection<string>)new Collection<string> { GetCxsItemMoniker(GetVariablePath(e.LengthVariable.Name)) }, caseFullFilePath, ((MMViewModel)this).GetProductName());
			if (asiSelectionXml != null)
			{
				dataObject.SetData(DataFormats.GetDataFormat("ASI Format").Name, asiSelectionXml);
			}
			double? value = e.LengthVariable.Value;
			dataObject.SetData(DataFormats.Text, value.HasValue ? value.Value.ToString() : string.Empty);
			DragDrop.DoDragDrop(sender as DependencyObject, dataObject, DragDropEffects.Copy);
		}

			if (asiFileXml != null)
			{
				dataObject.SetData(DataFormats.GetDataFormat("ASI File Format").Name, asiFileXml);
			}
			string asiSelectionXml = ClipboardHelper.GetAsiSelectionXml((ICollection<string>)new Collection<string> { GetCxsItemMoniker(GetVariablePath(e.StringVariable.Name)) }, caseFullFilePath, ((MMViewModel)this).GetProductName());
			if (asiSelectionXml != null)
			{
				dataObject.SetData(DataFormats.GetDataFormat("ASI Format").Name, asiSelectionXml);
			}
			string value = e.StringVariable.Value;
			dataObject.SetData(DataFormats.Text, value);
			DragDrop.DoDragDrop(sender as DependencyObject, dataObject, DragDropEffects.Copy);
		}

		private void InitializeContextMenu(TrayDiagram td)
		{
			td.InputBoxContextMenu.Items.Clear();
			MenuItem newItem = new MenuItem
			{
				Icon = GetContextItemIcon("Copy16.ico"),
				Command = ApplicationCommands.Copy,
				Header = Resources.strCopy,
				CommandBindings = 
				{
					new CommandBinding(ApplicationCommands.Copy, Copy_Executed, Copy_CanExecute)
				}
			};
			td.InputBoxContextMenu.Items.Add(newItem);
			MenuItem newItem2 = new MenuItem
			{
				Icon = GetContextItemIcon("Paste16.ico"),
				Command = ApplicationCommands.Paste,
				Header = Resources.strPaste,
				CommandBindings = 
				{
					new CommandBinding(ApplicationCommands.Paste, Paste_Executed, Paste_CanExecute)
				}
			};
			td.InputBoxContextMenu.Items.Add(newItem2);
			MenuItem newItem3 = new MenuItem
			{
				Icon = GetContextItemIcon("Clear16.ico"),
				Command = ClearCommand,
				CommandBindings = 
				{
					new CommandBinding(ClearCommand, Clear_Executed, Clear_CanExecute)
				}
			};
			td.InputBoxContextMenu.Items.Add(newItem3);
		}

		private static Image GetContextItemIcon(string strImage)
		{
			Image image = new Image();
			string text = "pack://application:,,,/" + typeof(MMBatchSep_ColumnInternals_Geometry_ViewModel).Assembly.FullName + ";component/Images/";
			image.Source = new BitmapImage(new Uri(text + strImage));
			return image;
		}

		private void Copy_CanExecute(object sender, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			e.CanExecute = ((sender as MenuItem).CommandParameter as LengthVariable)?.Value.HasValue ?? false;
		}

		private void Copy_Executed(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			LengthVariable lengthVariable = (sender as MenuItem).CommandParameter as LengthVariable;
			ClipboardHelper.CreateClipboard((ICollection<string>)new Collection<string>(new string[1] { GetCxsItemMoniker(GetVariablePath(lengthVariable.Name)) }), lengthVariable.Value.ToString(), ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.Case.CaseFullFilePath, ((MMViewModel)this).GetProductName());
		}

		private void TrayTypeDiagramCopy_CanExecute(object sender, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			MenuItem menuItem = sender as MenuItem;
			if (menuItem.CommandParameter is StringVariable)
			{
				StringVariable stringVariable = menuItem.CommandParameter as StringVariable;
				e.CanExecute = stringVariable != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(stringVariable.Value) && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(stringVariable.Value);
			}
			else if (menuItem.CommandParameter is LengthVariable)
			{
				Copy_CanExecute(sender, e);
			}
		}

		private void TrayTypeDiagramCopy_Executed(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			MenuItem menuItem = sender as MenuItem;
			if (menuItem.CommandParameter is StringVariable)
			{
				StringVariable stringVariable = menuItem.CommandParameter as StringVariable;
				ClipboardHelper.CreateClipboard((ICollection<string>)new Collection<string>(new string[1] { GetCxsItemMoniker(GetVariablePath(stringVariable.Name)) }), stringVariable.Value, ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.Case.CaseFullFilePath, ((MMViewModel)this).GetProductName());
			}
			else if (menuItem.CommandParameter is LengthVariable)
			{
				Copy_Executed(sender, e);
			}
		}

		private void TrayTypeDiagramPaste_CanExecute(object sender, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			MenuItem menuItem = sender as MenuItem;
			if (menuItem.CommandParameter is StringVariable)
			{
				try
				{
					string value = ClipboardWrapper.GetData(DataFormats.Text) as string;
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) && !(menuItem.CommandParameter as StringVariable).IsReadOnly)
					{
						comBoEditorValueToPaste = value;
						e.CanExecute = true;
					}
					return;
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (menuItem.CommandParameter is LengthVariable)
			{
				Paste_CanExecute(sender, e);
			}
		}

		private void TrayTypeDiagramPaste_Executed(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			MenuItem menuItem = sender as MenuItem;
			if (menuItem.CommandParameter is StringVariable)
			{
				StringVariable obj = menuItem.CommandParameter as StringVariable;
				ClipboardWrapper.GetData(DataFormats.Text);
				obj.Value = comBoEditorValueToPaste;
			}
			else if (menuItem.CommandParameter is LengthVariable)
			{
				Paste_Executed(sender, e);
			}
		}

		private string GetVariablePath(string propName)
		{
			if (DiagramVariables.ContainsKey(propName))
			{
				return $"@main.Input.{DiagramVariables[propName]}.@option_id.@id";
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void Paste_CanExecute(object sender, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			try
			{
				if ((sender as MenuItem).CommandParameter is LengthVariable lengthVariable)
				{
					string text = ClipboardWrapper.GetData(DataFormats.Text) as string;
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && lengthVariable != null && !lengthVariable.IsReadOnly && double.TryParse(text, out var result))
					{
						valueToPaste = result;
						e.CanExecute = true;
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}

		private void Paste_Executed(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			LengthVariable obj = (sender as MenuItem).CommandParameter as LengthVariable;
			ClipboardWrapper.GetData(DataFormats.Text);
			obj.Value = valueToPaste;
		}

		private void Clear_CanExecute(object sender, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			LengthVariable lengthVariable = (sender as MenuItem).CommandParameter as LengthVariable;
			e.CanExecute = lengthVariable != null && lengthVariable.Value.HasValue && !lengthVariable.IsReadOnly && !lengthVariable.IsDefaultValued;
		}

				((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.CA_DC_CLEAR.@option_id.@id", "value", (string)null, (object)null);
				break;
			case "SideDowncomerTopWidth":
				((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.CA_DC_WTOP_S.@option_id.@id", "value", (string)null, (object)null);
				break;
			case "SideDowncomerBottomWidth":
				((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.CA_DC_WBOT_S.@option_id.@id", "value", (string)null, (object)null);
				break;

				((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.CA_DC_WTOP_O.@option_id.@id", "value", (string)null, (object)null);

				((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.CA_DC_WBOT_O.@option_id.@id", "value", (string)null, (object)null);

		private void TrayTypeDiagramClear_CanExecute(object sender, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			MenuItem menuItem = sender as MenuItem;
			if (menuItem.CommandParameter is StringVariable)
			{
				StringVariable stringVariable = menuItem.CommandParameter as StringVariable;
				e.CanExecute = stringVariable != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(stringVariable.Value) && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(stringVariable.Value) && !stringVariable.IsReadOnly && !stringVariable.IsDefaultValued;
			}
			else if (menuItem.CommandParameter is LengthVariable)
			{
				Clear_CanExecute(sender, e);
			}
			else
			{
				e.CanExecute = false;
			}
		}

		private void TrayTypeDiagramClear_Executed(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			MenuItem menuItem = sender as MenuItem;
			if (menuItem.CommandParameter is StringVariable)
			{
				(menuItem.CommandParameter as StringVariable).Value = null;
			}
			else if (menuItem.CommandParameter is LengthVariable)
			{
				Clear_Executed(sender, e);
			}
			UpdateDiagram();
		}

		private string GetCxsItemMoniker(string dataPath)
		{
			return "cxs:" + ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath(dataPath).Replace("appModelV8", "appModel");
		}

		protected override void OnSubPropertyDataChanged(CxvPropertyDeclaration pd, string subPropertyName)
		{
			if (pd.Name == "SectionType_MultipMap" && subPropertyName == "SelectedItem")
			{
				UpdateCAValues();
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).OnSubPropertyDataChanged(pd, subPropertyName);
		}

		protected override void OnViewChanged()
		{
			if (((MMViewModel)this).View is MMBatchSep_ColumnInternals_Geometry mMBatchSep_ColumnInternals_Geometry)
			{
				if (_trayediagram == null)
				{
					_trayediagram = mMBatchSep_ColumnInternals_Geometry.trayedDiagram;
					InitializeContextMenu(_trayediagram);
					_trayediagram.DataDragStarting += _diagram_DataDragStarting;
				}
				if (_trayedTypeDiagram == null)
				{
					_trayedTypeDiagram = mMBatchSep_ColumnInternals_Geometry.trayedTypeDiagram;
					InitializeContextMenuForTrayTypeDiagram(_trayedTypeDiagram);
					_trayedTypeDiagram.DataDragStarting += _diagram_DataDragStarting;
					_trayedTypeDiagram.ComBoEditorDataDragStarting += _trayTypeDiagram_ComBoEditorDataDragStarting;
				}
				if (_vendorTrayediagram == null)
				{
					_vendorTrayediagram = mMBatchSep_ColumnInternals_Geometry.vendorTrayedDiagram;
					InitializeContextMenu(_vendorTrayediagram);
					_vendorTrayediagram.DataDragStarting += _diagram_DataDragStarting;
				}
				if (_vendorTrayedTypeDiagram == null)
				{
					_vendorTrayedTypeDiagram = mMBatchSep_ColumnInternals_Geometry.vendorTrayedTypeDiagram;
					InitializeContextMenuForTrayTypeDiagram(_vendorTrayedTypeDiagram);
					_vendorTrayedTypeDiagram.DataDragStarting += _diagram_DataDragStarting;
					_vendorTrayedTypeDiagram.ComBoEditorDataDragStarting += _trayTypeDiagram_ComBoEditorDataDragStarting;
				}
			}
			UpdateCAValues();
			((MMViewModel)this).OnViewChanged();
		}

		private void UpdateCAValues()
		{
			_isUpdatingDefaultValues = true;
			SimulatorCADataProvider.UpdateDefaultValues((MMViewModel)(object)this);
			_isUpdatingDefaultValues = false;
			string value = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("option_id"));
			string value2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.CA_ACTIVE.@option_id.@id", "value", (string)null, (CxvPropertyWatch)null));
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(value2))
			{
				UpdateDiagram();
			}
		}

		private Tuple<string, TrayDiagram, TrayTypeDiagram> GetActiveTrayedAndTrayedTypeDiagram()
		{
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.CA_INTERNAL.@option_id.@id", "value", (string)null));
			if (text == "TRAY")
			{
				return new Tuple<string, TrayDiagram, TrayTypeDiagram>("TRAY", _trayediagram, _trayedTypeDiagram);
			}
			if (text == "VENDOR-TRAY")
			{
				return new Tuple<string, TrayDiagram, TrayTypeDiagram>("VENDOR-TRAY", _vendorTrayediagram, _vendorTrayedTypeDiagram);
			}
			return new Tuple<string, TrayDiagram, TrayTypeDiagram>(text, null, null);
		}

		private void UpdateDiagram()
		{
			//IL_0078: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0082: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (_isUpdatingDefaultValues)
			{
				return;
			}
			Tuple<string, TrayDiagram, TrayTypeDiagram> activeTrayedAndTrayedTypeDiagram = GetActiveTrayedAndTrayedTypeDiagram();
			if (activeTrayedAndTrayedTypeDiagram.Item1 != "TRAY" && activeTrayedAndTrayedTypeDiagram.Item1 != "VENDOR-TRAY")
			{
				return;
			}
			TrayDiagram item = activeTrayedAndTrayedTypeDiagram.Item2;
			TrayTypeDiagram item2 = activeTrayedAndTrayedTypeDiagram.Item3;
			if (_diaWatch != null)
			{
				_diaWatch.PropertyDependencyChanged -= _diaWatch_PropertyDependencyChanged;
			}
			if (_diaWatch != null)
			{
				_diaWatch.Clear();
			}
			else
			{
				_diaWatch = new CxvPropertyWatch();
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveViewPropertyPath("TrayType_var1.Value", _diaWatch);
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveViewPropertyPath("NumOfPasses_var1.Value", _diaWatch);
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveViewPropertyPath("DeckThickness_var1.Value", _diaWatch);
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveViewPropertyPath("DeckThickness_var2.Value", _diaWatch);
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveViewPropertyPath("ActiveArea_var1.Value", _diaWatch);
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveViewPropertyPath("NumOfCaps_var1.Value", _diaWatch);
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveViewPropertyPath("NumOfValvesPerArea_var1.Value", _diaWatch);
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveViewPropertyPath("NumOfValves_var1.Value", _diaWatch);
			GetLastBlockID();
			CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("option_id"));
			CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("id"));
			CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.CA_INTERNAL.@option_id.@id", "value", (string)null, _diaWatch));
			int? num = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.CA_NPASS.@option_id.@id", "value", (string)null, _diaWatch));
			if (num.HasValue && item != null)
			{
				item.PassesCount = num.Value;
				if (activeTrayedAndTrayedTypeDiagram.Item1 == "TRAY")
				{
					item.PassesCount = 1;
				}
			}
			TrayGeometryData trayGeometryData = item.GeometryData;
			if (trayGeometryData == null)
			{
				trayGeometryData = new TrayGeometryData
				{
					LengthConverter = LengthConverter
				};
			}
			if (activeTrayedAndTrayedTypeDiagram.Item1 == "VENDOR-TRAY")
			{
				trayGeometryData.SideDowncomerClearance.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			}
			else
			{
				trayGeometryData.SideDowncomerClearance.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			bool isReadOnly = false;
			if (activeTrayedAndTrayedTypeDiagram.Item1 == "VENDOR-TRAY" && item2 != null)
			{
				switch (CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.CA_TRAYTYPE.@option_id.@id", "value", (string)null, _diaWatch)))
				{
				case "SIEVE":
					item2.TrayType = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Controls.TrayTypes.TrayTypeEnum.SieveTray;
					break;
				case "BUBBLE-CAP":
				case "CAPS":
					item2.TrayType = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Controls.TrayTypes.TrayTypeEnum.BubbleCapTray;
					break;
				case "NUTTER-BDP":
					item2.TrayType = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Controls.TrayTypes.TrayTypeEnum.NutterFloatValveBDPTray_125;
					break;
				case "NUTTER-BDH":
					item2.TrayType = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Controls.TrayTypes.TrayTypeEnum.NutterFloatValveBDPTray_61;
					break;
				case "BALLAST-V1":
					item2.TrayType = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Controls.TrayTypes.TrayTypeEnum.KochGlistchFlexitrayAValveTray;
					break;
				case "BALLAST-V4":
					item2.TrayType = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Controls.TrayTypes.TrayTypeEnum.KochGlistchFlexitrayAValveTray;
					break;
				case "FLEX-AO":
					item2.TrayType = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Controls.TrayTypes.TrayTypeEnum.KochGlistchFlexitrayAValveTray;
					break;
				case "FLEX-A14":
					item2.TrayType = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Controls.TrayTypes.TrayTypeEnum.KochGlistchFlexitrayAValveTray;
					isReadOnly = true;
					break;
				case "FLEX-A16":
					item2.TrayType = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Controls.TrayTypes.TrayTypeEnum.KochGlistchFlexitrayAValveTray;
					isReadOnly = true;
					break;
				case "FLEX-A18":
					item2.TrayType = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Controls.TrayTypes.TrayTypeEnum.KochGlistchFlexitrayAValveTray;
					isReadOnly = true;
					break;
				case "FLEX-TO":
					item2.TrayType = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Controls.TrayTypes.TrayTypeEnum.KochGlistchFlexitrayTValveTray;
					break;
				case "FLEX-T14":
					item2.TrayType = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Controls.TrayTypes.TrayTypeEnum.KochGlistchFlexitrayTValveTray;
					isReadOnly = true;
					break;
				case "FLEX-T16":
					item2.TrayType = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Controls.TrayTypes.TrayTypeEnum.KochGlistchFlexitrayTValveTray;
					isReadOnly = true;
					break;
				case "FLEX-T18":
					item2.TrayType = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Controls.TrayTypes.TrayTypeEnum.KochGlistchFlexitrayTValveTray;
					isReadOnly = true;
					break;
				case "FLEX-S":
					item2.TrayType = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Controls.TrayTypes.TrayTypeEnum.KochGlistchFlexitraySValveTray;
					break;
				}
			}
			_isAssigningGeometryValue = true;
			try
			{
				trayGeometryData.UnitsSource = FilteredUnitList;
				double? value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.CA_DIAM.@option_id.@id", "value", (string)null, _diaWatch));
				string units = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.CA_DIAM.@option_id.@id", "uom", (string)null, _diaWatch));
				bool? flag = CxsConverter.ValueToBoolean(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.CA_DIAM.@option_id.@id", "user_entered"));
				trayGeometryData.Diameter.Value = value;
				trayGeometryData.Diameter.Units = units;
				trayGeometryData.Diameter.IsDefaultValued = !flag.HasValue || !flag.Value;
				double? value2 = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.CA_TRAY_SPC.@option_id.@id", "value", (string)null, _diaWatch));
				string units2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.CA_TRAY_SPC.@option_id.@id", "uom", (string)null, _diaWatch));

				string units3 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.CA_DC_WTOP_C.@option_id.@id", "uom", (string)null, _diaWatch));
				bool? flag2 = CxsConverter.ValueToBoolean(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.CA_DC_WTOP_C.@option_id.@id", "user_entered"));
				trayGeometryData.CenterDowncomerTopWidth.Value = value3;
				trayGeometryData.CenterDowncomerTopWidth.Units = units3;
				trayGeometryData.CenterDowncomerTopWidth.IsDefaultValued = !flag2.HasValue || !flag2.Value;
				double? value4 = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.CA_DC_WBOT_C.@option_id.@id", "value", (string)null, _diaWatch));

		private string GetLastBlockID()
		{
			string text = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main");
			text = text.Replace("Top.appModelV8.", string.Empty);
			int num = text.LastIndexOf("Blocks.", text.Length - 1, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
			int num2 = text.IndexOf(".", num + 7);
			if (num2 == -1)
			{
				num2 = text.Length - 1;
			}
			int num3 = num2 - num - 7;
			return text.Substring(0, num + 7 + num3).Replace("Data.Blocks.", string.Empty).Replace("Blocks.", string.Empty);
		}

		private void _diaWatch_PropertyDependencyChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!_isUpdatingUnits && !_isUpdatingDefaultValues && !_inPropertyDependencyChanged)
			{
				_inPropertyDependencyChanged = true;
				UpdateCAValues();
				((MMViewModel)this).UpdateDisplay((object)null);
				((MMViewModel)this).UpdateAll();
				_inPropertyDependencyChanged = false;
			}
		}

		private double LengthConverter(double srcLength, string srcUnits, string destUnits)
		{
			double result = srcLength;
			if (UnitsDict.ContainsKey(srcUnits) && UnitsDict.ContainsKey(destUnits))
			{
				result = srcLength * UnitsDict[srcUnits] / UnitsDict[destUnits];
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void cmdDuplicate_CommandExecute(object parameter)

			{

			}

				MmgExtensions.CopyTPSARSections((MMViewModel)(object)this, text, num3);

		private string CreateNewVariableName(string name, string suffix)
		{
			if (name.Length < 8 - suffix.Length)
			{
				return name + suffix;
			}
			return name.Substring(0, 8 - suffix.Length) + suffix;
		}

		private void cmdDelete_Command_Execute(object args)
		{
			if (args != null)
			{
				((MMViewModel)this).DeleteChildren(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main"), (IEnumerable<string>)new Collection<string> { args as string }, false);
			}
			else
			{
				IEnumerable<string> selectedIds = GetSelectedIds();
				((MMViewModel)this).DeleteChildren(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main"), selectedIds, false);
			}
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider != null)
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.InvokeAction("Top.appModelV8.Custom Actions", "CAClearCache", false, (object[])null);
			}
		}

		}

		private IEnumerable<string> GetSelectedIds()
		{
			IList gridData = grdColumnInternalOptions_Data as IList;
			foreach (int selectedRowIndex in SelectedRowIndexes)
			{

				{
					grdColumnInternalOptions_Data_ItemTemplate grdColumnInternalOptions_Data_ItemTemplate = gridData[selectedRowIndex] as grdColumnInternalOptions_Data_ItemTemplate;
					yield return grdColumnInternalOptions_Data_ItemTemplate.GetId();
				}
			}
		}

		private string GetLastBlockID()

		private void SetDBVal(string propertyName, double dbvalue)
		{
			string text = null;
			text = ((!(dbvalue > -9E+34) || !(dbvalue < 9E+34)) ? string.Empty : dbvalue.ToString(Getdspstr(dbvalue), CultureInfo.CurrentCulture));
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter(propertyName, (object)text);
		}

		private string Getdspstr(double cvtval)
		{
			string text = null;
			if (Math.Abs(cvtval) < 1E-06)
			{
				return "0.#####E-##";
			}
			if (Math.Abs(cvtval) < 1.0)
			{
				return "0.#######";
			}
			if (Math.Abs(cvtval) < 10.0)
			{
				return "##.######";
			}
			if (Math.Abs(cvtval) < 100.0)
			{
				return "###.#####";
			}
			if (Math.Abs(cvtval) < 1000.0)
			{
				return "######.####";
			}
			if (Math.Abs(cvtval) < 10000.0)
			{
				return "#######.###";
			}
			return "0.#####E+##";
		}

		}

		private void MMCmdOK_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if ((bool)((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("CheckSave"))
			{
				SetSaveDB("YES");
			}
			else
			{
				SetSaveDB("NO");
			}
			for (int i = 0; i <= 2; i++)
			{
				if (!(bool)((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("Check" + i))
				{
					continue;
				}
				string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(ICxvViewDataContainerExtensions.ResolveViewPropertyPath((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "Current" + i + "_Data.DataPath"));
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					object obj = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("DB" + i);
					if (obj != null)
					{
						double num = Convert.ToDouble(obj, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
						((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet(text, "value", (object)num);
					}
				}
			}
			for (int j = 3; j <= 5; j++)
			{
				if (!(bool)((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("Check3"))
				{
					continue;
				}
				string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(ICxvViewDataContainerExtensions.ResolveViewPropertyPath((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "Current" + j + "_Data.DataPath"));
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
				{
					object obj2 = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("DB" + j);
					if (obj2 != null)
					{
						double num2 = Convert.ToDouble(obj2, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
						((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet(text2, "value", (object)num2);
					}
				}
			}
			for (int k = 6; k <= 7; k++)
			{
				if (!(bool)((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("Check" + (k - 2)))
				{
					continue;
				}
				string text3 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(ICxvViewDataContainerExtensions.ResolveViewPropertyPath((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "Current" + k + "_Data.DataPath"));
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3))
				{
					object obj3 = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("DB" + k);
					if (obj3 != null)
					{
						double num3 = Convert.ToDouble(obj3, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
						((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet(text3, "value", (object)num3);
					}
				}
			}
			SetSaveDB("DEFAULT");
			((MMViewModel)this).CloseForm();
		}

		private void MMCmdCancel_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			SetSaveDB("DEFAULT");
			((MMViewModel)this).CloseForm();
		}

		}

		protected override void OnSubPropertyDataChanged(CxvPropertyDeclaration pd, string subPropertyName)
		{
			if (_hasLoaded && !_isUpdatingDefaultValues)
			{
				_isUpdatingDefaultValues = true;
				Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(UpdateDefaultValues), DispatcherPriority.Input);
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).OnSubPropertyDataChanged(pd, subPropertyName);
		}

		private void UpdateDefaultValues()
		{
			if (!((CxvViewModel)this).IsUnloaded)
			{
				SimulatorCADataProvider.UpdateDefaultValues((MMViewModel)(object)this);
			}
			_isUpdatingDefaultValues = false;
		}

		protected override void OnViewChanged()
		{
			_hasLoaded = true;
			GetLastBlockID();
			CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("option_id"));
			CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("id"));
			((MMViewModel)this).OnViewChanged();
		}

		private string GetLastBlockID()
		{
			string text = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main");
			text = text.Replace("Top.appModelV8.", string.Empty);
			int num = text.LastIndexOf("Blocks.", text.Length - 1, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
			int num2 = text.IndexOf(".", num + 7);
			if (num2 == -1)
			{
				num2 = text.Length - 1;
			}
			int length = num2 - num - 7;
			return text.Substring(num + 7, length);
		}

		public override void OnViewClosed()
		{
			GetLastBlockID();
			CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("option_id"));
			CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("id"));
			((MMViewModel)this).OnViewClosed();
		}

			case 70:

				break;
			case 71:

				break;

				break;

				lbtuPR_CurveNo = (MMSpinBox)target;
				break;
			case 74:

				break;
			case 75:
				lbtuPR_Warning = (MMVariableEdit)target;
				break;
			case 76:

				break;
			case 77:
				cboPR_Dpmeth = (MMComboEdit)target;
				break;

				break;
			}
		}

		private bool IsTrayRating()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_blockId))
			{
				_blockId = GetLastBlockID();
			}
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("option_id"));
			string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("id"));
			string text3 = default(string);
			int num = default(int);
			HelperFuncs.GetColAnalysisSectionParams(_blockId, text, text2, "CA-SIZING", ref text3, ref num);
			string text4 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.CA_INTERNAL.@option_id.@id", "value", (string)null, _diaWatch));
			if ((text3 == "RATING" || text3 == "INTER-SIZING") && text4 == "TRAY")
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void UpdateCAValues()
		{
			_isUpdatingDefaultValues = true;
			SimulatorCADataProvider.UpdateDefaultValues((MMViewModel)(object)this);
			_isUpdatingDefaultValues = false;
			if (IsTrayRating())
			{
				UpdateDiagram();
			}
		}

		private void _diagram_DataDragStarting(object sender, DataDragStartingEventArgs e)
		{
			e.Handled = true;
			string caseFullFilePath = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.Case.CaseFullFilePath;
			IDataObject dataObject = e.DataObject;
			MemoryStream asiFileXml = ClipboardHelper.GetAsiFileXml(caseFullFilePath, ((MMViewModel)this).GetProductName());
			if (asiFileXml != null)
			{
				dataObject.SetData(DataFormats.GetDataFormat("ASI File Format").Name, asiFileXml);
			}
			string asiSelectionXml = ClipboardHelper.GetAsiSelectionXml((ICollection<string>)new Collection<string> { GetCxsItemMoniker(GetVariablePath(e.LengthVariable.Name)) }, caseFullFilePath, ((MMViewModel)this).GetProductName());
			if (asiSelectionXml != null)
			{
				dataObject.SetData(DataFormats.GetDataFormat("ASI Format").Name, asiSelectionXml);
			}
			double? value = e.LengthVariable.Value;
			dataObject.SetData(DataFormats.Text, value.HasValue ? value.Value.ToString() : string.Empty);
			DragDrop.DoDragDrop(sender as DependencyObject, dataObject, DragDropEffects.Copy);
		}

		private void InitializeContextMenu()
		{
			_diagram.InputBoxContextMenu.Items.Clear();
			MenuItem newItem = new MenuItem
			{
				Command = ApplicationCommands.Copy,
				Header = Resources.strCopy,
				CommandBindings = 
				{
					new CommandBinding(ApplicationCommands.Copy, Copy_Executed, Copy_CanExecute)
				}
			};
			_diagram.InputBoxContextMenu.Items.Add(newItem);
			MenuItem newItem2 = new MenuItem
			{
				Command = ApplicationCommands.Paste,
				Header = Resources.strPaste,
				CommandBindings = 
				{
					new CommandBinding(ApplicationCommands.Paste, Paste_Executed, Paste_CanExecute)
				}
			};
			_diagram.InputBoxContextMenu.Items.Add(newItem2);
			MenuItem newItem3 = new MenuItem
			{
				Command = ClearCommand,
				CommandBindings = 
				{
					new CommandBinding(ClearCommand, Clear_Executed, Clear_CanExecute)
				}
			};
			_diagram.InputBoxContextMenu.Items.Add(newItem3);
		}

		private void InitializeContextMenuForTrayTypeDiagram()

				CommandBindings =

					new CommandBinding(ApplicationCommands.Copy, TrayTypeDiagramCopy_Executed, TrayTypeDiagramCopy_CanExecute)
				}
			};
			_trayTypeDiagram.InputBoxContextMenu.Items.Add(newItem);
			MenuItem newItem2 = new MenuItem
			{
				Command = ApplicationCommands.Paste,
				Header = Resources.strPaste,
				CommandBindings = 
				{
					new CommandBinding(ApplicationCommands.Paste, TrayTypeDiagramPaste_Executed, TrayTypeDiagramPaste_CanExecute)
				}
			};
			_trayTypeDiagram.InputBoxContextMenu.Items.Add(newItem2);
			MenuItem newItem3 = new MenuItem
			{
				Command = ClearCommand,
				CommandBindings = 
				{
					new CommandBinding(ClearCommand, TrayTypeDiagramClear_Executed, TrayTypeDiagramClear_CanExecute)
				}
			};
			_trayTypeDiagram.InputBoxContextMenu.Items.Add(newItem3);
		}

		private void Copy_CanExecute(object sender, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			e.CanExecute = ((sender as MenuItem).CommandParameter as LengthVariable)?.Value.HasValue ?? false;
		}

		private void TrayTypeDiagramCopy_CanExecute(object sender, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			MenuItem menuItem = sender as MenuItem;
			if (menuItem.CommandParameter is StringVariable)
			{
				StringVariable stringVariable = menuItem.CommandParameter as StringVariable;
				e.CanExecute = stringVariable != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(stringVariable.Value) && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(stringVariable.Value);
			}
			else if (menuItem.CommandParameter is LengthVariable)
			{
				Copy_CanExecute(sender, e);
			}
		}

		private void Copy_Executed(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			LengthVariable lengthVariable = (sender as MenuItem).CommandParameter as LengthVariable;

		}

		private void TrayTypeDiagramCopy_Executed(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)

		private void Paste_CanExecute(object sender, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			try
			{
				if ((sender as MenuItem).CommandParameter is LengthVariable lengthVariable)
				{
					string text = ClipboardWrapper.GetData(DataFormats.Text) as string;
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && lengthVariable != null && !lengthVariable.IsReadOnly && double.TryParse(text, out var result))
					{
						valueToPaste = result;
						e.CanExecute = true;
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}

		private void TrayTypeDiagramPaste_CanExecute(object sender, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			MenuItem menuItem = sender as MenuItem;
			if (menuItem.CommandParameter is StringVariable)
			{
				try
				{
					string value = ClipboardWrapper.GetData(DataFormats.Text) as string;
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) && !(menuItem.CommandParameter as StringVariable).IsReadOnly)
					{
						comBoEditorValueToPaste = value;
						e.CanExecute = true;
					}
					return;
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (menuItem.CommandParameter is LengthVariable)
			{
				Paste_CanExecute(sender, e);
			}
		}

		private void Paste_Executed(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			LengthVariable obj = (sender as MenuItem).CommandParameter as LengthVariable;
			ClipboardWrapper.GetData(DataFormats.Text);
			obj.Value = valueToPaste;
		}

		private void TrayTypeDiagramPaste_Executed(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			MenuItem menuItem = sender as MenuItem;
			if (menuItem.CommandParameter is StringVariable)
			{
				StringVariable obj = menuItem.CommandParameter as StringVariable;
				ClipboardWrapper.GetData(DataFormats.Text);
				obj.Value = comBoEditorValueToPaste;
			}
			else if (menuItem.CommandParameter is LengthVariable)
			{
				Paste_Executed(sender, e);
			}
		}

		private string GetCxsItemMoniker(string dataPath)
		{
			return "cxs:" + ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath(dataPath).Replace("appModelV8", "appModel");
		}

		private void _trayTypeDiagram_ComBoEditorDataDragStarting(object sender, ComBoEditorDataDragStartingEventArgs e)
		{
			e.Handled = true;
			string caseFullFilePath = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.Case.CaseFullFilePath;
			IDataObject dataObject = e.DataObject;
			MemoryStream asiFileXml = ClipboardHelper.GetAsiFileXml(caseFullFilePath, ((MMViewModel)this).GetProductName());
			if (asiFileXml != null)
			{
				dataObject.SetData(DataFormats.GetDataFormat("ASI File Format").Name, asiFileXml);
			}
			string asiSelectionXml = ClipboardHelper.GetAsiSelectionXml((ICollection<string>)new Collection<string> { GetCxsItemMoniker(GetVariablePath(e.StringVariable.Name)) }, caseFullFilePath, ((MMViewModel)this).GetProductName());
			if (asiSelectionXml != null)
			{
				dataObject.SetData(DataFormats.GetDataFormat("ASI Format").Name, asiSelectionXml);
			}
			string value = e.StringVariable.Value;
			dataObject.SetData(DataFormats.Text, value);
			DragDrop.DoDragDrop(sender as DependencyObject, dataObject, DragDropEffects.Copy);
		}

		private string GetVariablePath(string propName)
		{
			if (DiagramVariables.ContainsKey(propName))
			{
				return $"@main.Input.{DiagramVariables[propName]}.@option_id.@id";
			}
			return null;
		}

					TrayTypeDiagram.TrayType = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Controls.TrayTypes.TrayTypeEnum.KochGlistchFlexitrayTValveTray;

					TrayTypeDiagram.TrayType = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Controls.TrayTypes.TrayTypeEnum.KochGlistchFlexitrayTValveTray;

		public double LengthConverter(double srcLength, string srcUnits, string destUnits)
		{
			double result = srcLength;
			if (UnitsDict.ContainsKey(srcUnits) && UnitsDict.ContainsKey(destUnits))
			{
				result = srcLength * UnitsDict[srcUnits] / UnitsDict[destUnits];
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void GoToNodeEx(string path)
		{
			string mainPath = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main");
			if (mainPath.Contains("Blocks"))
			{
				mainPath = mainPath.Replace("Data.", "").Substring(mainPath.IndexOf("Blocks"));
			}
			else
			{
				mainPath = mainPath.Replace("Top.appModelV8.", "");
			}
			mainPath = mainPath.Replace(".Subobjects", "") + "." + path.Substring(2);
			IShellMainWindow activeWindow = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IShellApplication>(((CxvViewModel)this).UnityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).ActiveWindow;
			ScreenContentControl val = activeWindow.FindScreen((Func<ScreenContentControl, bool>)delegate(ScreenContentControl s)
			{
				if (string.Equals(s.ScreenFactoryKey, ScreenFactoryKeys.ApwnFormContentFactory, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					dynamic screenSubject = s.ScreenSubject;
					return string.Equals(screenSubject.ShowFormArgs.FormKey, mainPath, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
				}
				return false;
			});
			if (val != null)
			{
				activeWindow.ActivateScreen(val);
			}
			else
			{
				((MMViewModel)this).GoToNode($"Simulation!{mainPath}", (string)null, true);
			}
		}

			}

			string text2 = "Column Internals";
			int startIndex = sConfigOption.IndexOf(text2) + text2.Length + 1;
			string[] array = sConfigOption.Substring(startIndex).Split('.');
			string text3 = string.Empty;
			if (array.Count() > 0)

		private string GetLastBlockID()
		{
			string text = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main");
			text = text.Replace("Top.appModelV8.", string.Empty);
			int num = text.LastIndexOf("Blocks.", text.Length - 1, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
			int num2 = text.IndexOf(".", num + 7);
			if (num2 == -1)
			{
				num2 = text.Length - 1;
			}
			int num3 = num2 - num - 7;
			return text.Substring(0, num + 7 + num3).Replace("Data.Blocks.", string.Empty).Replace("Blocks.", string.Empty);
		}

		}

		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{

				}
				_cxsCase.Message += cxsCase_Message;
			}
			CheckFormComplete();
			((MMTabPageViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
		}

		public override void Unload()
		{
			_cxsCase.Message -= cxsCase_Message;
			((CxvViewModel)this).Unload();
		}

			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

					break;

				{

				}
			}
		}

		{
			UnityContainer = unityContainer;

		public void ShowHydraulicPlotsScreen(string mainPath, int? displayStartStage, int? displayEndStage, string screenTitle)
		{
			//IL_003d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0059: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0064: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0092: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a9: Expected O, but got Unknown
			IShellMainWindow obj = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IShellMainWindow>(UnityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			string columnOptionKey = GetFullPathOnlyContainsBlocks(mainPath) + ".Subobjects.Column Internals." + GetColumnOptionKey(mainPath);
			SectionViewInfo sectionViewInfo = new SectionViewInfo
			{
				DisplayStartStage = displayStartStage,
				DisplayEndStage = displayEndStage
			};
			obj.ShowScreen(new ShowScreenEventArgs
			{
				ReuseExisting = (ShowScreenReuseOptions)1,
				PaneName = "HydraulicPlotsScreenFactoryKey",
				ScreenFactoryKey = "HydraulicPlotsScreenFactoryKey",
				ScreenSubject = (ScreenSubject)(object)new HydraulicPlotsScreenSubject
				{
					ColumnKey = GetFullPathOnlyContainsBlocks(mainPath),
					SuggestedScreenTitle = screenTitle,
					ColumnOptionKey = columnOptionKey,
					SectionViewInfo = sectionViewInfo
				},
				ScreenState = (ScreenState)(object)new HydraulicPlotsScreenState(),
				InitialLocation = (ScreenLocation)0
			});
		}

		private string GetColumnOptionKey(string mainPath)
		{
			string text = "Column Internals";
			int num = mainPath.IndexOf(text);
			int num2 = mainPath.IndexOf('.', num + text.Length + 1);
			return mainPath.Substring(num + text.Length + 1, num2 - num - text.Length - 1);
		}

		private string GetFullPathOnlyContainsBlocks(string mainPath)
		{
			string empty = string.Empty;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(mainPath))
			{
				int num = mainPath.LastIndexOf("Blocks.", mainPath.Length - 1, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
				int num2 = mainPath.IndexOf(".", num + 7);
				if (num2 == -1)
				{
					return mainPath;
				}
				return mainPath.Substring(0, num2);
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}
	}

		protected override void OnSubPropertyDataChanged(CxvPropertyDeclaration pd, string subPropertyName)
		{
			//IL_0067: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_010b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			((CxvViewModel)this).OnSubPropertyDataChanged(pd, subPropertyName);
			if (!(subPropertyName == "Units"))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (pd.Name == "BubblingAreaA_var1" || pd.Name == "BubblingAreaB_var1" || pd.Name == "BubblingAreaC_var1" || pd.Name == "BubblingAreaD_var1")
			{
				string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(((CxvVariableProperty)pd.Metadata).DataPath, "uom"));

		private void UnifyUnits(string[] variablePaths, string unit)
		{

			{
				if (CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(variablePaths[i], "uom")) != unit)

				}
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
		}

				}
				return _cmdView_Command;
			}
		}

		private void cmdView_CommandExecuted(object args)
		{
			string text = args as string;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				string text2 = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main1.Column Internals.@id.Sections." + text + ".Results").Replace("Top.appModelV8.", "").Replace(".Data", "");
				((MMViewModel)this).GoToNode(text2, (string)null, true);
			}
		}

		{

			{
				SimulatorCADataProvider.RunWithHydraulicFlagOnVM((MMViewModel)(object)this);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateOptionSectionNames()
		{
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0037: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (_optionNamesWatch != null)
			{
				_optionNamesWatch.PropertyDependencyChanged -= _optionNamesWatch_PropertyDenpendencyChanged;
				_optionNamesWatch.Clear();
			}
			else
			{
				_optionNamesWatch = new CxvPropertyWatch();
			}
			OptionNames.Clear();
			Collection<string> collection = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Subobjects.Column Internals", "child_ids", (string)null, _optionNamesWatch));
			if (collection != null)
			{
				foreach (string item in collection)
				{
					OptionNames.Add(item);
				}
				if (!OptionNames.Contains(SelectedOption))
				{
					SelectedOption = OptionNames[0];
				}
			}
			if (!_optionNamesWatch.IsEmpty)
			{
				_optionNamesWatch.PropertyDependencyChanged += _optionNamesWatch_PropertyDenpendencyChanged;
			}
			else
			{
				_optionNamesWatch = null;
			}
		}

		private void _optionNamesWatch_PropertyDenpendencyChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateOptionSectionNames();
		}

		protected override void OnViewChanged()
		{
			UpdateOptionSectionNames();
			((MMViewModel)this).OnViewChanged();
		}

		private void _columnsetWatch_PropertyDependencyChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateColumnSet();
		}

		private void UpdateColumnSet()
		{
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0037: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0a79: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0a7e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0a8a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (_columnsetWatch != null)
			{
				_columnsetWatch.PropertyDependencyChanged -= _columnsetWatch_PropertyDependencyChanged;
				_columnsetWatch.Clear();
			}
			else
			{
				_columnsetWatch = new CxvPropertyWatch();
			}
			int? num = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.CC Nodes.TRUSER.@option_id.@id", "value", (string)null, _columnsetWatch));
			int? num2 = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.CC Nodes.TSUSER.@option_id.@id", "value", (string)null, _columnsetWatch));
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(ICxvViewDataContainerExtensions.ResolveViewPropertyPath((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "Views_Selected.Value"));
			string text2 = null;
			object isMDTray = IsMDTray;
			if (((CxvLogicalPropertyData)((isMDTray is CxvLogicalPropertyData) ? isMDTray : null)).Value)
			{
				switch (text)
				{
				case "Hydraulic results":
					if (num == 0 && num2 == 0)
					{
						text2 = "trayNo,jetFlood,dryPresDrop,totalPresDrop,dryPresDrop_Head,totalPresDrop_Head,downcomerBackup,downcomerBackupUnaerated,downcomerBackupPercent,downcomerBackupPercentUnaerated,massRatePerArea,volumnRatePerArea,fsNetArea,fsBubblingArea,csNetArea,csBubblingArea,approachLimit,heightOverWeir,heightOverWeirUnaerated,mdLongestDCExitVelocity,mdMedianDCExitVelocity,mdShortestDCExitVelocity,mdLongestDCVolume,mdMedianDCVolume,mdShortestDCVolume,mdLongestDCResidenceTime,mdLongestDCApparentResidenceTime,mdMedianDCResidenceTime,mdMedianDCApparentResidenceTime,mdShortestDCResidenceTime,mdShortestDCApparentResidenceTime,mdLongestDCVelocityTop,mdMedianDCVelocityTop,mdShortestDCVelocityTop,mdLongestDCChokeFlood,mdMedianDCChokeFlood,mdShortestDCChokeFlood,mdAveragedWeirLoading";
					}
					if (num == 1)
					{
						text2 = "trayNo,jetFlood,totalPresDrop,downcomerBackupPercent,downcomerBackup";
					}
					if (num2 == 1)
					{
						text2 = "trayNo,totalPresDrop,Diameter,TotalArea,ActiveAreaPerPanel";
					}
					break;
				case "Hydraulic results-Short":
					if (num == 0 && num2 == 0)
					{
						text2 = "trayNo,jetFlood,downcomerBackupPercent,totalPresDrop,liquidMassFlow,vaporMassFlow,liquidMassDensity,vaporMassDensity,liquidVicosity,vaporVicosity,surfaceTension,mdLongestDCChokeFlood,mdMedianDCChokeFlood,mdShortestDCChokeFlood,mdAveragedWeirLoading";
					}
					if (num == 1)

		private string GetLastBlockID()
		{
			_mainNodePath = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main");
			string text = _mainNodePath.Replace("Top.appModelV8.", string.Empty);
			int num = text.LastIndexOf("Blocks.", text.Length - 1, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
			int num2 = text.IndexOf(".", num + 7);
			if (num2 == -1)
			{
				num2 = text.Length - 1;
			}
			int length = num2 - num - 7;
			return text.Substring(num + 7, length);
		}

		protected override void OnViewChanged()
		{
			string lastBlockID = GetLastBlockID();
			string sOptionId = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("option_id"));
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_mainNodePath))
			{
				sOptionId = CxsPath.ParentPath(CxsPath.ParentPath(CxsPath.ParentPath(_mainNodePath)));
			}
			string sSectionId = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("id"));
			if (!SimulatorCADataProvider.CAResultAvailable(lastBlockID, sOptionId, sSectionId))
			{
				SimulatorCADataProvider.UpdateDefaultValuesForSectionResultForm((MMViewModel)(object)this);
			}
			object view = ((MMViewModel)this).View;
			((DispatcherObject)((view is MMTabPage) ? view : null))?.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Loaded, (Action)delegate
			{
				UpdateColumnSet();
				UpdateColumnSet2();
			});
			((MMViewModel)this).OnViewChanged();
		}

		public override void OnViewClosed()
		{
			GetLastBlockID();
			CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("option_id", (CxvPropertyWatch)null));
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_mainNodePath))
			{
				CxsPath.ParentPath(CxsPath.ParentPath(CxsPath.ParentPath(_mainNodePath)));
			}
			CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("id"));
			((MMViewModel)this).OnViewClosed();
		}

	[ProgId("MMRadfrac.MMRadfrac_ColumnInternals_Results_Bystage")]
	public class MMRadfrac_ColumnInternals_Results_Bystage : MMTabPage, IComponentConnector
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty TrayRatingFieldSetsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("TrayRatingFieldSets", typeof(string), typeof(MMRadfrac_ColumnInternals_Results_Bystage), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnTrayRatingFieldSetsPropertyChanged));

		private bool _loaded;

		internal MMLabel MMLabel2_View;

		internal MMComboEdit MMComboEdit2_View;

		internal MMScrollAreaMS grdTime;

		internal MMLabel MMLabel_View;

		internal MMComboEdit MMComboEdit_View;

		internal AdsDataGrid grdTrayRatingAds;

		private bool _contentLoaded;

		public string TrayRatingFieldSets
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)((DependencyObject)this).GetValue(TrayRatingFieldSetsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)this).SetValue(TrayRatingFieldSetsProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		public MMRadfrac_ColumnInternals_Results_Bystage()
		{
			((MMViewModelContainer)this).ViewModelType = typeof(MMRadfrac_ColumnInternals_Results_Bystage_ViewModel);
			InitializeComponent();
			((FrameworkElement)this).Loaded += MMRadfrac_ColumnInternals_Results_Bystage_Loaded;
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			((FrameworkElement)this).SetBinding(TrayRatingFieldSetsProperty, (BindingBase)new Binding("TrayRatingFieldSets")
			{
				Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
			});
			((FrameworkElement)this).OnInitialized(e);
		}

		private void MMRadfrac_ColumnInternals_Results_Bystage_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!_loaded)
			{
				_loaded = true;
				UpdateTrayRatingAdsDataGridFields();
			}
		}

		public void UpdateTrayRatingAdsDataGridFields()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(TrayRatingFieldSets))
			{
				return;
			}
			List<string> list = new List<string>(TrayRatingFieldSets.Split(','));
			Visibility centerPassParameterVisibility = GetCenterPassParameterVisibility();
			Visibility offCenterPassParameterVisibility = GetOffCenterPassParameterVisibility();
			foreach (AdsField field in grdTrayRatingAds.Fields)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(field.Key))
				{
					if (!list.Contains(field.Key))
					{
						field.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					}
					else if (IsCenterPassField(field))
					{
						field.Visibility = centerPassParameterVisibility;
					}
					else if (IsOffCenterPassField(field))
					{
						field.Visibility = offCenterPassParameterVisibility;
					}
					else
					{
						field.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private bool IsCenterPassField(AdsField field)
		{
			return string.Equals(field.Tag as string, "Center", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
		}

		private bool IsOffCenterPassField(AdsField field)
		{
			return string.Equals(field.Tag as string, "OffCenter", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
		}

		private Visibility GetCenterPassParameterVisibility()
		{
			if (((MMViewModelContainer)this).ViewModel is MMRadfrac_ColumnInternals_Results_Bystage_ViewModel { center_used: not null, center_used: var center_used })
			{
				bool? flag = ((dynamic)center_used).Value as bool?;
				if (flag.HasValue && flag.Value)
				{
					return Visibility.Visible;
				}
			}
			return Visibility.Collapsed;
		}

		private Visibility GetOffCenterPassParameterVisibility()
		{
			if (((MMViewModelContainer)this).ViewModel is MMRadfrac_ColumnInternals_Results_Bystage_ViewModel { offcenter_used: not null, offcenter_used: var offcenter_used })
			{
				bool? flag = ((dynamic)offcenter_used).Value as bool?;
				if (flag.HasValue && flag.Value)
				{
					return Visibility.Visible;
				}
			}
			return Visibility.Collapsed;
		}

		private static void OnTrayRatingFieldSetsPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(d as MMRadfrac_ColumnInternals_Results_Bystage).UpdateTrayRatingAdsDataGridFields();

		private string GetLastBlockID()
		{
			_mainNodePath = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main");
			string text = _mainNodePath.Replace("Top.appModelV8.", string.Empty);
			int num = text.LastIndexOf("Blocks.", text.Length - 1, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
			int num2 = text.IndexOf(".", num + 7);
			if (num2 == -1)
			{
				num2 = text.Length - 1;
			}
			int length = num2 - num - 7;
			return text.Substring(num + 7, length);
		}

		{

			{
				SimulatorCADataProvider.UpdateDefaultValuesForSectionResultForm((MMViewModel)(object)this);
			}
			((MMViewModel)this).OnViewChanged();
		}

		public override void OnViewClosed()
		{
			GetLastBlockID();

				CxsPath.ParentPath(CxsPath.ParentPath(CxsPath.ParentPath(_mainNodePath)));
			}
			CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("id"));
			((MMViewModel)this).OnViewClosed();

		private string GetLastBlockID()
		{
			_mainNodePath = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main");
			string text = _mainNodePath.Replace("Top.appModelV8.", string.Empty);
			int num = text.LastIndexOf("Blocks.", text.Length - 1, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
			int num2 = text.IndexOf(".", num + 7);
			if (num2 == -1)
			{
				num2 = text.Length - 1;
			}
			int length = num2 - num - 7;
			return text.Substring(num + 7, length);
		}

		protected override void OnViewChanged()
		{
			string lastBlockID = GetLastBlockID();
			string sOptionId = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("option_id"));
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_mainNodePath))
			{
				sOptionId = CxsPath.ParentPath(CxsPath.ParentPath(CxsPath.ParentPath(_mainNodePath)));
			}
			string sSectionId = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("id"));
			if (!SimulatorCADataProvider.CAResultAvailable(lastBlockID, sOptionId, sSectionId))
			{
				SimulatorCADataProvider.UpdateDefaultValuesForSectionResultForm((MMViewModel)(object)this);
			}
			((MMViewModel)this).OnViewChanged();
		}

		public override void OnViewClosed()
		{
			GetLastBlockID();
			CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("option_id"));
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_mainNodePath))
			{
				CxsPath.ParentPath(CxsPath.ParentPath(CxsPath.ParentPath(_mainNodePath)));
			}
			CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("id"));
			((MMViewModel)this).OnViewClosed();
		}

	public class SummarVMVariableConvert : IValueConverter
	{
		private Dictionary<string, string> convertDic = new Dictionary<string, string>
		{
			{
				"Sizing",
				GridFormsResources.MMRadfrac_ColumnInternals_Results_Summa_Sizing
			},
			{
				"Rating",
				GridFormsResources.MMRadfrac_ColumnInternals_Results_Summa_Rating
			},
			{
				"None",
				GridFormsResources.MMRadfrac_ColumnInternals_Results_Summa_None
			}
		};

		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value == null || value == DBNull.Value)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string text = (string)value;
			if (text != null && convertDic.ContainsKey(text))
			{
				return convertDic[text].ToString();
			}
			return value;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

			protected override void OnUpdateData()
			{
				if (((CxvViewModel)this).IsInitialUpdate)
				{
					SpacingUnits = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveViewPropertyPath("Spacing_var1.Units", (CxvPropertyWatch)null));
				}

			}

			protected override void OnSubPropertyDataChanged(CxvPropertyDeclaration pd, string subPropertyName)
			{
				//IL_0116: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_011b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0126: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_012d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0135: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0145: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (pd.Name == "Spacing_var1" && (subPropertyName == "Units" || subPropertyName == "Value"))
				{
					SpacingUnits = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveViewPropertyPath("Spacing_var1.Units", (CxvPropertyWatch)null));
				}
				if (pd.Name == "Spacing_var1" && subPropertyName == "Value" && !isCheckingTraySpacing)
				{
					isCheckingTraySpacing = true;
					string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.@y.Input.CA_INTERNAL.@option_id.@y", "value"));
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && string.Equals(text, "TRAY", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
					{
						double? num = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.@y.Input.CA_TRAY_SPC.@option_id.@y", "value", "meter"));
						if (num.HasValue && (!_tspacing.HasValue || _tspacing.Value != num.Value))
						{
							_tspacing = num.Value;
							if (num.Value > 2.0)
							{
								((CxvViewModel)this).ShowMessageBox(new ShowMessageBoxEventArgs
								{
									Message = Resources.TraySpacingTooLarge,
									MsgBoxButton = MessageBoxButton.OK,
									MsgBoxImage = MessageBoxImage.Exclamation,
									Title = Resources.MsgBox_Title_Aspen_Plus
								});
							}
						}
					}
					isCheckingTraySpacing = false;
				}
				((CxvViewModel)this).OnSubPropertyDataChanged(pd, subPropertyName);
			}

			public string GetId()

			private void ConvertTraySpacingValueWithUnits(string units)
			{
				object spacing_var = Spacing_var1;
				CxvVariableData val = (CxvVariableData)((spacing_var is CxvVariableData) ? spacing_var : null);
				if (val != null && !string.Equals(val.Units, units, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					string dataPath = val.DataPath;
					double? num = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(dataPath, "value", units));
					if (num.HasValue && !num.Equals(val.Value))
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.SuspendNotifications();
						int num2 = MmgSor.MMinqcpt();
						int num3 = MmgSor.MMinqpgc();
						int num4 = MmgSor.MMinqnec();
						((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet(dataPath, "value", units, (object)num);
						MmgSor.MMsetcpt(num2);
						MmgSor.MMsetpgc(num3);
						MmgSor.MMsetnec(num4);
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.ResumeNotifications();
					}
				}
			}

		public bool DoesSelectedRecordExist
		{
			get
			{
				IList list = grdColumnInternalOptions_Data as IList;
				if (SelectedRowIndexes != null && SelectedRowIndexes.Count == 1 && list[SelectedRowIndexes[0]] is grdColumnInternalOptions_Data_ItemTemplate grdColumnInternalOptions_Data_ItemTemplate)
				{
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(grdColumnInternalOptions_Data_ItemTemplate.GetId()))
					{
						return false;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private string CreateNewVariableName(string name, string suffix)
		{
			if (name.Length < 8 - suffix.Length)
			{
				return name + suffix;
			}
			return name.Substring(0, 8 - suffix.Length) + suffix;
		}

			}

				if (val != null && val.Complete.HasValue && !val.Complete.Value)
				{
					return;
				}
			}

			{

					columnAnalyzerModel.UpdateColumnInternalLevelResultData(sOptionKey);

			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<string> GetSelectedIds()
		{
			IList gridData = grdColumnInternalOptions_Data as IList;
			foreach (int selectedRowIndex in SelectedRowIndexes)
			{
				if (selectedRowIndex >= 0 && selectedRowIndex < gridData.Count)
				{
					grdColumnInternalOptions_Data_ItemTemplate grdColumnInternalOptions_Data_ItemTemplate = gridData[selectedRowIndex] as grdColumnInternalOptions_Data_ItemTemplate;
					yield return grdColumnInternalOptions_Data_ItemTemplate.GetId();
				}
			}
		}

		private string GetLastBlockID()
		{
			string text = "@main.@parent.@parent.@parent.@parent.@parent";
			string text2 = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath(text);
			text2 = text2.Replace("Top.appModelV8.", string.Empty);
			int num = text2.LastIndexOf("Blocks.", text2.Length - 1, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
			int num2 = text2.IndexOf(".", num + 7);
			if (num2 == -1)
			{
				num2 = text2.Length;
			}
			int num3 = num2 - num - 7;
			return text2.Substring(0, num + 7 + num3).Replace("Data.Blocks.", string.Empty).Replace("Blocks.", string.Empty);
		}

		private void SetPUpdateEnable()
		{
			int? num = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("p_IsSectionGap"));
			string text = "@main.@parent.@parent.Input.CA_ACTIVE1.@option_id";

			Collection<string> collection = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main", "child_ids", (string)null, _diaWatch));

					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateDiagram()
		{
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (_diaWatch != null)
			{
				_diaWatch.PropertyDependencyChanged -= _diaWatch_PropertyDependencyChanged;
			}
			if (_diaWatch != null)
			{
				_diaWatch.Clear();
			}
			else
			{
				_diaWatch = new CxvPropertyWatch();
			}
			Diagram.Sections.Clear();
			string text = "@main.@parent.@parent.@parent.@parent.@parent";
			string lastBlockID = GetLastBlockID();
			string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("option_id"));

			{
				Diagram.TotalStages = num.Value;
			}
			bool hasCondenser = true;
			if (CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(text + ".Input.CONDENSER", "value", (string)null, _diaWatch)) == "NONE")
			{
				hasCondenser = false;
			}
			Diagram.HasCondenser = hasCondenser;
			bool hasReboiler = true;
			if (CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(text + ".Input.REBOILER", "value", (string)null, _diaWatch)) == "NONE")
			{
				hasReboiler = false;
			}
			Diagram.HasReboiler = hasReboiler;
			Collection<string> collection = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main", "child_ids", (string)null, _diaWatch));
			if (collection != null)
			{
				foreach (string item in collection)
				{
					CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(string.Format("@main.{0}.Input.CA_NPASS.@option_id.{0}", item), "value", (string)null, _diaWatch));
					double? num2 = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(string.Format("@main.{0}.Input.CA_DIAM.@option_id.{0}", item), "value", "meter", _diaWatch));
