		private void ExecuteAutoSectionStage(object args)
		{
			int topStage = 0;
			int botStage = 0;
			GetTopBottomStages(ref topStage, ref botStage);
			List<int> lStages = new List<int>();
			GetStages("FEED_STAGE", ref lStages);
			GetStages("DEST_STAGE", ref lStages);
			int count = lStages.Count;
			List<int> lStages2 = new List<int>();
			GetStages("PROD_STAGE", ref lStages2);
			GetStages("SOURCE_STAGE", ref lStages2);
			int count2 = lStages2.Count;
			Dictionary<int, double> lFlows = new Dictionary<int, double>();
			GetFlows("FEED_LFLOW", lStages, ref lFlows);
			Dictionary<int, double> lFlows2 = new Dictionary<int, double>();
			GetFlows("PROD_LFLOW", lStages2, ref lFlows2);
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			List<int> list2 = new List<int>();
			int num2;
			int num = (num2 = 0);
			int num3 = 0;
			list.Add(topStage);
			do
			{
				if (num2 < count2 && num < count)
				{
					int num4 = lStages[num];
					int num5 = lStages2[num2];
					if (num5 < num4)
					{
						num2++;
						if (num5 > list[num3] && num5 < botStage)
						{
							list2.Add(num5);
							goto IL_0225;
						}
						continue;
					}
					if (num5 > num4)
					{
						num++;
						if (num4 > list[num3] && num4 < botStage)
						{
							list2.Add(num4 - 1);
							goto IL_0225;
						}
						continue;
					}
					num++;
					num2++;
					if (num4 <= list[num3] || num5 >= botStage)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (lFlows.ContainsKey(num4) && lFlows2.ContainsKey(num5))
					{
						if (lFlows[num4] > lFlows2[num5])
						{
							list2.Add(num4 - 1);
						}
						else
						{
							list2.Add(num5);
						}
					}
					else if (lFlows2.ContainsKey(num5))
					{
						list2.Add(num5);
					}
					else
					{
						list2.Add(num4 - 1);
					}
					goto IL_0225;
				}
				if (num2 < count2)
				{
					int num6 = lStages2[num2];
					num2++;
					if (num6 > list[num3] && num6 < botStage)
					{
						list2.Add(num6);
						goto IL_0225;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					int num7 = lStages[num];
					num++;
					if (num7 > list[num3] && num7 < botStage)
					{
						list2.Add(num7 - 1);
						goto IL_0225;
					}
				}
				continue;
				IL_0225:
				list.Add(list2[num3] + 1);
				num3++;
			}
			while (num2 < count2 || num < count);
			list2.Add(botStage);
			CreateSections(list, list2);
			string diameterErrorInfoUnderInteractiveSizing = GetDiameterErrorInfoUnderInteractiveSizing();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(diameterErrorInfoUnderInteractiveSizing))
			{
				MessageBox.Show(diameterErrorInfoUnderInteractiveSizing, ApwnResources.CAMessageBoxCaptionWarning, MessageBoxButton.OK);
			}
		}

		private void ExecuteAutoSectionFlow(object args)
		{
			int topStage = 0;
			int botStage = 0;
			GetTopBottomStages(ref topStage, ref botStage);
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			for (int i = topStage; i < botStage; i++)
			{
				list.Add(i);
			}
			Dictionary<int, double> lFlows = new Dictionary<int, double>();
			GetFlows("LIQ_FLOW", list, ref lFlows);
			if (lFlows.Count == 0)
			{
				MessageBox.Show(ApwnResources.AutoSectionBasedOnFlow, ApwnResources.AutoSectionBasedOnFlowTitle, MessageBoxButton.OK);
				return;
			}
			List<int> list2 = new List<int>();
			List<int> list3 = new List<int>();
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			list2.Add(topStage);
			foreach (int key in lFlows.Keys)
			{
				num4 = lFlows[key];
				if (num2 > 0 && Math.Abs(num4 - num3) > 0.2 * num4)
				{
					list3.Add(key - 1);
					list2.Add(list3[num] + 1);
					num++;
				}
				num3 = num4;
				num2++;
			}
			list3.Add(botStage);
			CreateSections(list2, list3);
		}

		private void GetTopBottomStages(ref int topStage, ref int botStage)
		{
			string text = "@main.@parent.@parent.";
			string text2 = text + "Input.NSTAGE";
			int? num = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(text2, "value", (string)null));
			if (num.HasValue && num.HasValue)
			{

		private void GetStages(string varName, ref List<int> lStages)
		{
			string text = "@main.@parent.@parent.Input." + varName;
			string[] array = CxsConverter.ValueToStringArray(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(text, "child_ids"));
			if (array == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string[] array2 = array;
			foreach (string text2 in array2)
			{
				string text3 = text + "." + text2;
				int? num = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(text3, "value", (string)null));
				if (num.HasValue && num.HasValue)
				{
					int value = num.Value;
					if (!lStages.Contains(value))
					{
						lStages.Add(value);
					}
				}
			}
			lStages.Sort();
		}

		private void GetFlows(string varName, List<int> lStages, ref Dictionary<int, double> lFlows)
		{
			string text = "@main.@parent.@parent.Output." + varName;
			for (int i = 0; i < lStages.Count; i++)
			{
				int key = lStages[i];
				string text2 = text + "." + key;
				double? num = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(text2, "value", (string)null));
				if (num.HasValue && num.HasValue)
				{
					double value = num.Value;
					if (!lFlows.ContainsValue(value))
					{
						lFlows.Add(key, value);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private string GetDiameterErrorInfoUnderInteractiveSizing()
		{
			Collection<string> collection = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main", "child_ids", (string)null));
			IColumnAnalyzerModel columnAnalyzerModel = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IColumnAnalyzerModel>(((CxvViewModel)this).UnityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			if (collection != null)
			{
				foreach (string item in collection)
				{
					string sConfigOptionKey = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("main", (CxvPropertyWatch)null));
					CASectionDefaultValue cASectionDefaultValue = columnAnalyzerModel.GetDefault(sConfigOptionKey, item);
					if (cASectionDefaultValue != null)
					{
						double? num = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(string.Format("@main.{0}.Input.CA_DIAM.@option_id.{0}", item), "value", "meter"));
						object obj = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(string.Format("@main.{0}.Input.CA_DIAM.@option_id.{0}", item), "uom", (string)null);
						string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(string.Format("@main.{0}.Input.CA_SIZING.@option_id.{0}", item), "value", (string)null));
						double num2 = HelperFuncs.ConvertValueToUserUnit(VariableHelper.GetPlusDimensionRow(cASectionDefaultValue.Diameter.QuantityType), "meter", cASectionDefaultValue.Diameter.Value);
						if (cASectionDefaultValue.Diameter.NullableValue.HasValue && !num.HasValue && text == "INTER-SIZING")
						{
							list.Add(string.Format(ApwnResources.CAMessageBoxTextDiameterErroInfo, num2, obj.ToString(), item));
						}
					}
				}
			}
			string text2 = string.Empty;
			foreach (string item2 in list)
			{
				text2 = text2 + item2 + "\n";
			}
			return text2;
		}

		private void SweptBackWeirDiagram_DataDragStarting(object sender, DataDragStartingEventArgs e)
		{
			e.Handled = true;
			string caseFullFilePath = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.Case.CaseFullFilePath;
			IDataObject dataObject = e.DataObject;
			MemoryStream asiFileXml = ClipboardHelper.GetAsiFileXml(caseFullFilePath, ((MMViewModel)this).GetProductName());
			if (asiFileXml != null)
			{
				dataObject.SetData(DataFormats.GetDataFormat("ASI File Format").Name, asiFileXml);
			}
			string asiSelectionXml = ClipboardHelper.GetAsiSelectionXml((ICollection<string>)new Collection<string> { GetCxsItemMoniker(GetVariablePath(e.LengthVariable.Name)) }, caseFullFilePath, ((MMViewModel)this).GetProductName());
			if (asiSelectionXml != null)
			{
				dataObject.SetData(DataFormats.GetDataFormat("ASI Format").Name, asiSelectionXml);
			}
			double? value = e.LengthVariable.Value;
			dataObject.SetData(DataFormats.Text, value.HasValue ? value.Value.ToString() : string.Empty);
			DragDrop.DoDragDrop(sender as DependencyObject, dataObject, DragDropEffects.Copy);
		}

		private void InitializeContextMenuForTrayTypeDiagram()
		{
			_sweptBackWeirDiagram.InputBoxContextMenu.Items.Clear();
			MenuItem newItem = new MenuItem
			{
				Command = ApplicationCommands.Copy,
				Header = Resources.strCopy,
				CommandBindings = 
				{
					new CommandBinding(ApplicationCommands.Copy, DiagramCopy_Executed, DiagramCopy_CanExecute)
				}
			};
			_sweptBackWeirDiagram.InputBoxContextMenu.Items.Add(newItem);
			MenuItem newItem2 = new MenuItem
			{
				Command = ApplicationCommands.Paste,
				Header = Resources.strPaste,
				CommandBindings = 
				{
					new CommandBinding(ApplicationCommands.Paste, DiagramPaste_Executed, DiagramPaste_CanExecute)
				}
			};
			_sweptBackWeirDiagram.InputBoxContextMenu.Items.Add(newItem2);
			MenuItem newItem3 = new MenuItem
			{
				Command = MMRadfrac_ColumnInternals_Geometry_ViewModel.ClearCommand,
				CommandBindings = 
				{
					new CommandBinding(MMRadfrac_ColumnInternals_Geometry_ViewModel.ClearCommand, DiagramClear_Executed, DiagramClear_CanExecute)
				}
			};
			_sweptBackWeirDiagram.InputBoxContextMenu.Items.Add(newItem3);
		}

		}

		private void Paste_Executed(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			LengthVariable obj = (sender as MenuItem).CommandParameter as LengthVariable;
			ClipboardWrapper.GetData(DataFormats.Text);
			obj.Value = valueToPaste;
		}

		private void Paste_CanExecute(object sender, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			try
			{
				if ((sender as MenuItem).CommandParameter is LengthVariable lengthVariable)
				{
					string text = ClipboardWrapper.GetData(DataFormats.Text) as string;
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && lengthVariable != null && !lengthVariable.IsReadOnly && double.TryParse(text, out var result))
					{
						valueToPaste = result;
						e.CanExecute = true;
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}

		private void Clear_Executed(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			string name = ((sender as MenuItem).CommandParameter as LengthVariable).Name;
			if (name != null)
			{
				int length = name.Length;
				if (length <= 13)
				{
					if (length != 1)
					{
						if (length == 13 && name == "SweptBackWeir")
						{
							goto IL_011a;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						char c = name[0];
						if (c != 'A')
						{
							if (c == 'B')
							{
								goto IL_0105;
							}
							if (c == 'S')
							{
								goto IL_011a;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.CA_SW_A.@option_id.@id", "value", (string)null, (object)null);
						}
					}
				}
				else if (length != 18)
				{
					if (length == 20 && name == "ParallelChordSegment")
					{
						goto IL_0105;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					switch (name[0])
					{
					case 'S':
						if (name == "SweptBackWeirChord")
						{
							((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.CA_SW_WF.@option_id.@id", "value", (string)null, (object)null);
						}
						break;
					case 'A':
						if (name == "AngledChordSegment")
						{
							((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.CA_SW_SF.@option_id.@id", "value", (string)null, (object)null);
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			goto IL_012d;
			IL_012d:
			UpdateDiagram();
			return;
			IL_011a:
			((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.CA_SW_S.@option_id.@id", "value", (string)null, (object)null);
			goto IL_012d;
			IL_0105:
			((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.CA_SW_B.@option_id.@id", "value", (string)null, (object)null);
			goto IL_012d;
		}

		protected override void OnSubPropertyDataChanged(CxvPropertyDeclaration pd, string subPropertyName)
		{

		}

		private void CheckFormComplete()
		{
			if (((MMViewModel)this).View is MMRadfrac_ColumnInternals_Geometry mMRadfrac_ColumnInternals_Geometry)
			{
				DependencyObject parent = ((FrameworkElement)(object)mMRadfrac_ColumnInternals_Geometry).Parent;
				MMTabItem val = (MMTabItem)(object)((parent is MMTabItem) ? parent : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_IsFormComplete", (object)val.Complete);
				}
			}
		}

		private void _diaWatch_PropertyDependencyChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!_isUpdatingDefaultValues && !_inPropertyDependencyChanged)
			{
				_inPropertyDependencyChanged = true;
				UpdateCAValues();
				((MMViewModel)this).UpdateDisplay((object)null);
				((MMViewModel)this).UpdateAll();
				_inPropertyDependencyChanged = false;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateCAValues()
		{
			_isUpdatingDefaultValues = true;
			SimulatorCADataProvider.UpdateDefaultValues((MMViewModel)(object)this);
			_isUpdatingDefaultValues = false;
			UpdateDiagram();
		}

		public string GetCxsItemMoniker(string dataPath)
		{
			return "cxs:" + ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath(dataPath).Replace("appModelV8", "appModel");
		}

		public string GetVariablePath(string propName)
		{
			if (DiagramVariables.ContainsKey(propName))
			{
				return $"@main.Input.{DiagramVariables[propName]}.@option_id.@id";
			}
			return null;
		}

		private string GetLastBlockID()
		{
			string text = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main");
			text = text.Replace("Top.appModelV8.", string.Empty);
			int num = text.LastIndexOf("Blocks.", text.Length - 1, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
			int num2 = text.IndexOf(".", num + 7);
			if (num2 == -1)
			{
				num2 = text.Length - 1;
			}
			int num3 = num2 - num - 7;
			return text.Substring(0, num + 7 + num3).Replace("Data.Blocks.", string.Empty).Replace("Blocks.", string.Empty);
		}

		public double LengthConverter(double srcLength, string srcUnits, string destUnits)
		{
			double result = srcLength;
			if (UnitsDict.ContainsKey(srcUnits) && UnitsDict.ContainsKey(destUnits))
			{
				result = srcLength * UnitsDict[srcUnits] / UnitsDict[destUnits];
			}
			return result;
		}

namespace AspenTech.AspenPlus.ColumnAnalysisIntegration.Converters
{
	internal class ColumnInternals_HydraulicResults_InternalsTypeConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			object result = value;
			switch (value as string)
			{
			case "TRAY":
				result = ApwnResources.MMRadfrac_ColumnInternals_Geometry_Type_Trayed;
				break;
			case "PACKING":
				result = ApwnResources.MMRadfrac_ColumnInternals_Geometry_Type_Packed;
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return value;
		}
	}
	internal class ColumnInternals_Results_TrayDowncomerLocationConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			object result = value;
			switch (value as string)
			{
			case "Side":
				result = ApwnResources.MMRadfrac_ColumnInternals_Geometry_ViewModel_DowncomersBasedGroup_MultiMapOption_1;
				break;
			case "Center":
				result = ApwnResources.MMRadfrac_ColumnInternals_Geometry_ViewModel_DowncomersBasedGroup_MultiMapOption_2;
				break;
			case "Off-Center":
				result = ApwnResources.MMRadfrac_ColumnInternals_GeoSummary_OffCenter_Label;
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return value;
		}
	}
